pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.name: Approximate
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.summary: Your magic quickly flows over an area to help you count and catalog.
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.description:
**Area** 1 cubic foot

Your magic quickly flows over an area to help you count and catalog. Name a particular type of object you're looking for within the area. You gain an instant estimate of the quantity of the chosen objects that are clearly visible within the target area. The number is rounded to the largest digit. For example, you could look at a pile of 180 copper coins, and you would learn that it held about 200 coins, but you couldn't determine there were exactly 180 coins.

The type of object you name can be as specific or general as you like—"dented copper coins" is as viable as "coins"—but the distinguishing features must be obvious at a glance, and the spell is fooled by objects disguised as other objects.

pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.name: Artistic Recollection
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.summary: You touch your finger to a blank surface and create an image of a person, place, or object.
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.description: You touch your finger to a blank surface and create an image of a person, place, or object. This image appears instantly in the style of a pastel-hued oil painting and disappears cleanly once the spell ends. The portrait is the size of one average sketchbook page and must represent a subject the caster has seen in person or has studied extensively.

pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.name: Create Earthen Facsimile
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.summary: You hold a clump of soil, and it morphs into a small figurine in your hand.
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.description: You hold a clump of soil, and it morphs into a small figurine in your hand. The soil transforms and hardens into a simple form of your choosing. While it does hold its shape if undisturbed, the figurine is brittle and will crumble under pressure or turn back to mush at the end of the spell's duration.
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Create Earthen Facsimile

pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.name: Frost's Touch
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.summary: Your gelid shard drinks down nearby heat in a futile attempt to sate itself and achieve a level of frigid cold unheard of in the universe.
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.description:
Your *gelid shard* drinks down nearby heat in a futile attempt to sate itself and achieve a level of frigid cold unheard of in the universe. This allows you to cool a drink, make a hot pot safe to handle, or other, similar minor effects. Once cooled, the object's temperature is subject to its environment as usual. You can also solidify ambient moisture into a solid object; this temporary object is of negligible Bulk, made of non-magical ice. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile—it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or locus or cost for a spell. Once created, it melts as normal for ice for the ambient conditions.

**Heightened (3rd)** You can create simple objects of ice with up to 1 Bulk and of a level not exceeding 1. Such objects must be rigid. You can only have one such object created at a time; if you create another, the previous object melts instantly.

**Heightened (5th)** Items you create can be up to 4 Bulk and 4th level.

**Heightened (7th)** Items you create can be up to 8 Bulk and 8th level.

**Heightened (9th)** Items you create can be up to 20 Bulk and 12th level.

pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.name: Infectious Enthusiasm
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.summary: With enchanted gusto, you encourage yourself to get things done and share your motivation with your allies.
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.description:
With enchanted gusto, you encourage yourself to get things done and share your motivation with your allies. You gain a +1 status bonus to your choice of attack rolls, Will saves, or Charisma-based skill checks. During the spell's duration, an ally who observed you Casting this Spell and was within 30 feet when you did so can take a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to gain the same bonus you chose until the start of their next turn.

Using this spell to influence someone in a social situation is typically considered a faux pas, negating the benefit on Charisma-based skills if the subject of the check observed you casting the spell.

Spell Effect: Infectious Enthusiasm

pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.name: Musical Accompaniment
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.summary: You're surrounded by orchestral music that shifts and changes to match your behavior.
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.description:
You're surrounded by orchestral music that shifts and changes to match your behavior. This music provides a +1 status bonus to Performance checks. At the GM's discretion, it provides this bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation checks as the music changes to support you in social situations, though some creatures are unaffected by such obvious attempts to use music to elicit specific emotions. This music moves with you and has a maximum volume equal to four humans shouting. You take a –4 circumstance penalty to Stealth checks while the music is playing. You can't control the exact music this spell creates, and the music doesn't create intelligible words or singing. You can Dismiss this spell.

Spell Effect: Musical Accompaniment

**Heightened (2nd)** The duration increases to 10 minutes.

pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.name: Phase Bolt
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.summary: You point your finger and project a bolt of magical energy that stutters in and out of phase until it reaches the target.
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.description:
You point your finger and project a bolt of magical energy that stutters in and out of phase until it reaches the target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against your target's AC; if the target has any circumstance bonuses to AC (such as from a shield or cover), reduce that bonus by 2 for this attack. On a success, you deal 3d4 piercing damage.

**Critical Success** The target takes double damage.

**Success** The target takes full damage.

**Heightened (+1)** The bolt's damage increases by 1d4.

pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.name: Protect Companion
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.targets: your eidolon, or a creature with the minion trait under your control
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.duration: until the start of your next turn
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.summary: You extend your aura, as a magical shield that protects your eidolon or minion.
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.description:
You extend your aura, as a magical shield that protects your eidolon or minion. The target gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. You gain the Life Block reaction; after using the reaction, the spell ends and you can't cast protect companion again for 10 minutes.

Spell Effect: Protect Companion

**Heightened (+2)** The reaction reduces the damage by another 10, and you lose 5 more Hit Points. If you want to lose fewer Hit Points, you can choose to lower the damage reduction and HP lost to what any lower-rank version of the spell could do without lowering the spell's actual rank.

pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.name: Read the Air
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.summary: You survey a social situation, showing courtesy to all around you as your intuition swiftly picks up clues about social contexts and unspoken assumptions of behavior.
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.description:
You survey a social situation, showing courtesy to all around you as your intuition swiftly picks up clues about social contexts and unspoken assumptions of behavior. Your body language subconsciously changes to take advantage of this information and use it in your own interactions with those creatures.

As part of Casting this Spell, you Recall Knowledge using Society to gain information about the social situation. You also gain a +1 status bonus to your next Diplomacy check to Make An Impression on those creatures present when you Cast this Spell, as long as the check occurs during the duration of the spell. You can *read the air* only once in a given social situation; casting it again has no effect.

Spell Effect: Read the Air
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Read the Air

pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.name: Tame
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.summary: As you make comforting sounds and gestures, you approach the target in a friendly manner combining caution and confidence.
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.description:
As you make comforting sounds and gestures, you approach the target in a friendly manner combining caution and confidence. You improve the target's attitude to you by one step (unfriendly to neutral, neutral to friendly, friendly to helpful) for the duration of the spell unless it succeeds at a Will save. Afterward, the target is temporarily immune for 1 day.

This spell works only on domesticated animals; for example, you could use it on guard dogs or stray dogs but not feral dogs or wolves. If the socialization of the animal is in question, the decision is up to the GM.

**Heightened (3rd)** The duration becomes 10 minutes.

**Heightened (6th)** The duration becomes 1 hour.

pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.name: Time Sense
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.summary: When you Cast the Spell, you gain a perfect sense of time.
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.description:
When you Cast the Spell, you gain a perfect sense of time. You can learn exactly what time it is, down to the second. You can instead choose to gain a perfect sense of the calendar if you have knowledge in that area—if you're trained in Nature, you can learn exactly how long it is until sunrise and how many days until the next solstice. If you're trained in Astronomy Lore, you can learn precisely when any known predictable astronomical conjunction will begin and end, and so on.

You can gain a +1 status bonus to one attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check you take on the same turn you cast time sense that requires extremely precise timing. If you choose to gain this bonus, you can't gain it again for 1 hour.

pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.name: Warp Step
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.summary: When you walk, the earth warps beneath your feet—your steps extend, distance contracts, and everything is just a little bit closer.
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.description:
When you walk, the earth warps beneath your feet—your steps extend, distance contracts, and everything is just a little bit closer. You gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed until the end of your turn. You then Stride twice. You can use warp step to Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Stride if you have the corresponding movement type.

Spell Effect: Warp Step

pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.name: Wash Your Luck
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.summary: Some practitioners argue this spell literally washes your fortunes of all influences, malign or benign, while others claim it simply cleanses your mind of obsessions about luck and destiny.
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.description:
Some practitioners argue this spell literally washes your fortunes of all influences, malign or benign, while others claim it simply cleanses your mind of obsessions about luck and destiny. You adjust your garments, change the posture of your chair, fidget with a religious symbol, or make some other innocuous and personally significant action to wash away bad luck.

Once during the spell's duration, before rolling a check, you can cancel out a misfortune effect on that roll, as normal when a fortune and misfortune effect apply to the same roll. After canceling out the misfortune effect, the spell ends, and you are then temporarily immune to *wash your luck* for 10 minutes.

Spell Effect: Wash Your Luck
pf2e-orc.spells.cantrips.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Wash Your Luck

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: 500 Toads
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You conjure hundreds of magical toads to fill the area and hop around.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description: You conjure hundreds of magical toads to fill the area and hop around. The vast quantity of hopping toads provides enough weight and height for the creatures to trigger any potential trap in the area that could be triggered by the weight, movement, or position of a Medium creature. The area is difficult terrain, and the magic reconstructs any toads destroyed by traps to keep the area full of toads for the duration of the spell.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Animal Allies
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You summon tiny, ordinary animals from the environment, such as insects, birds, or fish, to quickly lash out at nearby foes.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You summon tiny, ordinary animals from the environment, such as insects, birds, or fish, to quickly lash out at nearby foes. The animals swarm around the creatures in the area, dealing each of them 3d4 piercing damage with a basic Reflex save.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 3d4

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Biting Words
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.traits: attack, auditory, concentrate, linguistic, manipulate, sonic
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You entwine magic with your voice, causing your taunts and jibes to physically harm your enemies.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You entwine magic with your voice, causing your taunts and jibes to physically harm your enemies. You can attack with your words once when you finish Casting the Spell, and can repeat the attack once on each of your subsequent turns by taking a single action, which has the attack, concentrate, and linguistic traits. After your third attack total, the spell ends.

When you attack with biting words, make a ranged spell attack roll against a creature within 30 feet, dealing 2d6 sonic damage if you hit (or double damage on a critical hit).

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Blessing of Vigor
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You pray for a small blessing to keep your target safe.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You pray for a small blessing to keep your target safe. The target gains fast healing 3.

Spell Effect: Blessing of Vigor

**Heightened (+1)** The fast healing increases by 3.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Blessing of Vigor

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Bone Shield
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You create an expendable shield of rough, raw bone in a free hand that can easily be replaced over and over again.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You create an expendable shield of rough, raw bone in a free hand that can easily be replaced over and over again. When you Cast the Spell or the first time each round you Sustain this spell on subsequent rounds, you can Raise this Shield, granting you a +2 circumstance bonus to AC. While this spell is in effect, you gain the Shield Block reaction, but only with the bone shield. The bone shield has Hardness 3 and 1 HP (with no Broken Threshold). This shield also gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its Hardness against attacks that deal piercing or slashing damage. If the shield is destroyed, it's recreated already raised in a free hand when you Sustain the Spell.

**Heightened (+2)** The shield's Hardness increases by 3.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Breadcrumbs
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You protect your target from going astray in hostile territory by tracking where they've already been, helping the target deduce where they still need to go.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You protect your target from going astray in hostile territory by tracking where they've already been, helping the target deduce where they still need to go. The target leaves a glittering trail behind them that lasts for the spell's duration. This trail doesn't denote the direction or the order of its path—it merely indicates where the target has moved during the spell's duration.

**Heightened (2nd)** The duration increases to 8 hours.

**Heightened (3rd)** The duration increases to last until your next daily preparations.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Camel Spit
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You alter your stomach, esophagus, and tongue to be able to spit partially digested food with force.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You alter your stomach, esophagus, and tongue to be able to spit partially digested food with force. You can spit at a foe once you finish Casting the Spell and can repeat the attack once on each of your subsequent turns by taking a single action, which has the acid, attack, and concentrate traits. After your third spit attack, the spell ends. When you attack with camel spit, make a ranged spell attack roll against a creature within 15 feet, dealing 1d6 acid damage and causing the target to be dazzled for 1 round if you hit. On a critical hit, you deal double damage and the target takes (your level) persistent acid damage.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d6, and the persistent damage on a critical hit is increased by 1.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: Howl of the Wild — Spells: Camel Spit

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Cinder Scribe
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: Conjuring a quill of magical flame, you take an object and write a message onto it that disappears to the naked eye almost as soon as you finish writing it.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
Conjuring a quill of magical flame, you take an object and write a message onto it that disappears to the naked eye almost as soon as you finish writing it. If this message is written onto an object that can't withstand a burning fire, such as paper or leather, then the object is destroyed while you're writing it. If the inscribed object is thrust into a roaring fire, the writing on it is revealed for 1 minute before fading. The writing can be revealed this way any number of times, and it's erased only if it's counteracted by an effect similar to dispel magic or when the duration ends. Even if the object is destroyed, pieces of the message exist on its various parts. For example, if the object was turned to dust and recreated via remake, the message would remain intact.

**Heightened (2nd)** The duration increases to a year and a day.

**Heightened (4th)** The duration is unlimited.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Cradle Aloft
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.targets: 1 held object of 2 Bulk or less
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You temporarily release gravity's hold on an object, allowing you to let go of it without dropping it to the floor.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description: You temporarily release gravity's hold on an object, allowing you to let go of it without dropping it to the floor. The object floats next to you in your space, following you if you move. You can Interact to retrieve the object on your turn as a free action. If you're within reach of another creature, that creature can spend a single action with the attack trait to attempt an Athletics check against your spell DC, retrieving the object out of the air on a success. The creature must have a free hand to attempt this check. The spell ends if a creature successfully retrieves the object. If the object is floating when the spell ends, it falls.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Curse of Recoil
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You curse an enemy to suffer a kickback as they make a ranged attack, potentially causing them to miss.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
**Trigger** An enemy you can see is about to make a ranged attack.

You curse an enemy to suffer a kickback as they make a ranged attack, potentially causing them to miss. The triggering enemy attempts a Will save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The recoil from their ranged attack causes the target to be off-guard until the beginning of their next turn.

**Failure** The recoil imposes a –1 status penalty to the ranged attack and renders the target off-guard until the beginning of their next turn.

Spell Effect: Curse of Recoil (Failure)

**Critical Failure** The recoil imposes a –2 status penalty to the ranged attack and renders the target off-guard until the beginning of their next turn. Until the start of their next turn, any additional ranged attacks made with the same weapon, spell, or ability take the same penalty.

Spell Effect: Curse of Recoil (Critical Failure)

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Decompose
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You touch a corpse to speed up the decaying process.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You touch a corpse to speed up the decaying process. The target begins to rapidly decompose. After a day, any organic material will be gone, and after a week, any trace of the target will be gone.

**Heightened (3rd)** Organic material is gone within a minute, and any trace of the target is gone within an hour.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Dome of Tranquility
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: The air around you falls still and blocks out the sounds of the outside world.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
The air around you falls still and blocks out the sounds of the outside world. While you can clearly hear anything within this isolated dome, you can't hear anything outside of it. The opposite is also true, with no one outside of your dome being able to hear what's within. This dome doesn't block line of sight. If anything larger than 1 Bulk passes through it, the dome is automatically dispersed. You can Dismiss this spell.

**Heightened (3rd)** The duration increases to 8 hours.

**Heightened (5th)** The duration increases to 24 hours.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Dome of Tranquility

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Echoing Weapon
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You channel energy into the target weapon, and the air around it faintly hums each time it strikes a blow, as the impact is absorbed into the weapon.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You channel energy into the target weapon, and the air around it faintly hums each time it strikes a blow, as the impact is absorbed into the weapon. If a creature is wielding the weapon at the end of its turn, the weapon discharges a burst of sound targeting one creature adjacent to the wielder. The sonic damage dealt is equal to the number of successful Strikes with the target weapon that the wielder made that turn (to a maximum of 4 sonic damage if the wielder hits with four Strikes).

1: (1 per 2 levels) sonic, 2: level-based sonic, 3: level-based sonic, 4: level-based sonic

**Heightened (+2)** The sonic damage increases by 1 per Strike (and the maximum damage increases by 4).

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Fishing Spot
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You conjure a fishing rod and an extraplanar pool teeming with fish.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You conjure a fishing rod and an extraplanar pool teeming with fish. After 10 minutes of fishing, you catch a magical fish; roll 1d8 to see which fish you caught and the effects gained from eating it once it's cooked. The fish must be cooked and eaten (a process that takes about 30 minutes) within 1 hour of being caught, and the listed effect lasts for 1 hour after consumption. Each fish can feed only a single creature.

1. **Musical trout** +2 status bonus to Performance checks
2. **Primordial bass** +2 status bonus to Survival checks
3. **Ghoulfish** +2 status bonus to Intimidation checks
4. **Burbling barbel** +2 status bonus to Deception and Diplomacy checks
5. **Dashing dace** +2 status bonus to Acrobatics checks
6. **Vigocarp** +2 status bonus to Athletics checks to Climb and Swim
7. **Aggressive perch** +2 status bonus to Athletics checks to Disarm, Grapple, Reposition, Shove, and Trip
8. **Scholar salmon** +2 status bonus to checks to Recall Knowledge

Spell Effect: Fishing Spot

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Foraging Friends
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: Giving a cheerful whistle, you call forth a handful of small animals, such as birds or mice, to collect food for you and your allies.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
Giving a cheerful whistle, you call forth a handful of small animals, such as birds or mice, to collect food for you and your allies. The animals return 1 hour later with enough foraged goods to feed four Medium creatures for 1 day, then return to their normal behavior. If you're in a particularly strange environment, as determined by your GM, you might need a minimum proficiency with primal spell DCs, equivalent to the minimum proficiency required to Subsist in strange environments.

**Heightened (3rd)** The animals bring back enough food for eight Medium creatures for 1 day.

**Heightened (5th)** The animals bring back enough food for 30 Medium creatures for 1 day.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: Howl of the Wild — Spells: Foraging Friends

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Forced Mercy
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You soften the target's blows, ensuring they avoid vital areas and cause no lasting harm.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You soften the target's blows, ensuring they avoid vital areas and cause no lasting harm. All physical damage dealt by the target to living creatures becomes nonlethal and all persistent bleed damage dealt by the target is reduced to 0. This effect doesn't incur the typical –2 circumstance penalty for nonlethal attacks with a lethal weapon or attack. An unwilling target must attempt a Will save. A willing target can choose to critically fail their saving throw.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is affected for 1 round.

**Failure** The creature is affected for 1d4 rounds.

**Critical Failure** The creature is affected for 1 minute.

**Heightened (4th)** The range increases to 100 feet, and you can target up to 8 creatures.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Gravitational Pull
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: By suddenly altering gravity, you pull the target toward you.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
By suddenly altering gravity, you pull the target toward you. The target is pulled 10 feet closer to you unless it succeeds at a Fortitude save. On a critical failure, it's also knocked prone. The effects of this spell change depending on the number of actions you spend when you Cast this Spell.

◆ The spell targets one creature.

◆◆ (concentrate) The spell targets one creature and pulls the target 20 feet instead of 10.

◆◆◆ (concentrate) The spell targets up to five creatures.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Groom Companion
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: Companions can easily become covered in blood, dirt, and other nasty substances, creating a poor impression in noncombat situations.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description: Companions can easily become covered in blood, dirt, and other nasty substances, creating a poor impression in noncombat situations. When you Cast this Spell, you immediately clean your companion, trim their fur or nails as appropriate, and leave them smelling nice. Additionally, future dirt, grease, grime, and other nasty substances slide off the target, keeping them clean and groomed. Your companion gains a +1 status bonus to Performance checks. At the GM's discretion, your companion might be able to gain admittance to an establishment that wouldn't normally allow beasts for the duration of this spel l.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Hippocampus Retreat
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.requirements: You're mostly or totally submerged in water.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You temporarily shape your lower limbs into the tail of a hippocampus in order to swim away from a nearby foe after dealing a parting blow.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
**Requirements** You're mostly or totally submerged in water.

You temporarily shape your lower limbs into the tail of a hippocampus in order to swim away from a nearby foe after dealing a parting blow. Attempt a melee spell attack roll against the target's AC, dealing 2d6 bludgeoning damage on a hit (or double damage on a critical hit). Then, Swim up to 30 feet; if you already have a swim Speed, you can Swim up to your Speed with a +10-foot circumstance bonus. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC against reactions triggered by this movement. At the end of the movement, your lower limbs return to normal.

Spell Effect: Hippocampus Retreat

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d6.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: Howl of the Wild — Spells: Hippocampus Retreat

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Horizon Thunder Sphere
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You gather magical energy into your palm, forming a concentrated ball of electricity that crackles and rumbles like impossibly distant thunder.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You gather magical energy into your palm, forming a concentrated ball of electricity that crackles and rumbles like impossibly distant thunder. Make a ranged spell attack roll against your target's AC. On a success, you deal 3d6 electricity damage. On a critical success, the target takes double damage and is dazzled for 1 round. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its range as well as other parameters.

◆◆ This spell has a range of 30 feet.

◆◆◆ This spell has a range of 60 feet and deals half damage on a failure (but not a critical failure) as the electricity lashes out and jolts the target.

**Two Rounds** If you spend 3 actions Casting the Spell, you can avoid finishing the spell and spend another 2 actions on your next turn to empower the spell even further. You can take other actions before finishing this spell, but the spell is lost if you Cast another Spell in between. After attacking the target, whether you hit or miss, the ball of lightning explodes, dealing level-based electricity damage to all other creatures in a 10-foot emanation around the target (basic Reflex save). Additionally, you spark with electricity for 1 minute, dealing (your level) electricity damage to creatures that Grapple you or that hit you with an unarmed Strike or a non-reach melee weapon.

**Heightened (+1)** The initial damage on a hit, as well as the burst damage for 2-round casting time, each increase by 2d6, and the damage creatures take if they Grapple or hit you while you're in your sparking state increases by 1.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Horizon Thunder Sphere

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Juvenile Companion
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You transform your companion into its juvenile form, such as a cub, foal, kitten, puppy, or piglet, making the target appear small and harmless.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You transform your companion into its juvenile form, such as a cub, foal, kitten, puppy, or piglet, making the target appear small and harmless. It becomes Tiny (if it was larger), and its reach is reduced to 0 feet. All its Speeds are halved (to a minimum Speed of 5 feet), and it gains weakness 5 to physical damage. In all other ways, its abilities and statistics are unchanged.

If your companion uses a hostile action, *juvenile companion* ends. This spell has no effect on a companion that doesn't have a juvenile form.

Spell Effect: Juvenile Companion

**Heightened (2nd)** The duration increases to 1 hour.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Kinetic Ram
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: Gathering kinetic energy, you either focus it in a straight line or disperse it as an encircling ripple.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
Gathering kinetic energy, you either focus it in a straight line or disperse it as an encircling ripple. Any creature targeted by this spell must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from you (or 20 feet on a critical failure).

The spell's area or range and how many creatures it affects is based on how many actions you spend when Casting the Spell.

◆ The spell targets one creature within 15 feet.

◆◆ The spell targets one creature within 30 feet. The distance the target is pushed if it fails is doubled, and on a critical failure, the target is also knocked prone and takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage.

◆◆◆ The spell targets all creatures in a 5-foot emanation.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Lose the Path
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You surround a moving creature with lifelike illusions, shifting their perception of the terrain to subtly lead them off course.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
**Trigger** A creature in range Strides

You surround a moving creature with lifelike illusions, shifting their perception of the terrain to subtly lead them off course. The target must attempt a Will save. Regardless of the result, the creature is immune to *lose the path* for 1 hour.

**Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Failure** The creature treats all squares as difficult terrain for its Stride.

**Critical Failure** As failure, except that you determine where the target moves during the Stride, though you can't move it into hazardous terrain or to a place it can't stand.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Lose the Path

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Metal Merged
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You call forth the metal that flows through your veins, welding it together with the weapon you wield.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You call forth the metal that flows through your veins, welding it together with the weapon you wield. For the duration of this spell, you can't drop your weapon, and you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC against attempts to Disarm you.

Spell Effect: Metal Merged

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Necromancer's Generosity
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You channel void energy through your magical connection to your undead minion to strengthen the creature.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You channel void energy through your magical connection to your undead minion to strengthen the creature. The target regains 1d8+4 Hit Points when you Cast the Spell, and it gains a +2 status bonus to saves against vitality effects for the duration.

Spell Effect: Necromancer's Generosity

**Heightened (+1)** The amount of healing increases by 1d8+4.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Nudge the Odds
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You bestow yourself supernaturally good luck at cards, dice, and other games of chance.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You bestow yourself supernaturally good luck at cards, dice, and other games of chance. You gain a +1 status bonus to Games Lore checks to gamble, and if you roll a critical failure on such a check, you get a failure instead; however, the spell is too short-lived to use for Earn Income checks from gambling.

When you're under the effect of nudge the odds, one facial feature, such as a lock of hair or the iris of an eye, transforms to a distinctive golden color; the GM chooses which feature when you Cast the Spell. This change resists all magical efforts to conceal it, though it can be hidden or covered by mundane means. A creature noticing the feature can identify the spell using Recall Knowledge. Because it prevents losing big, gamblers consider nudge the odds a repugnant form of cheating. If you're caught using the spell, you're likely to suffer serious consequences depending on the nature of the gamblers you cheated.

Spell Effect: Nudge the Odds

**Heightened (5th)** The status bonus increases to +2, and the duration increases to lasting until the next time you make your daily preparations. If you continue spending your spell slot each day to keep the duration active, this allows you to apply the effect to a downtime check to Earn Income.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Nudge the Odds

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Propelling Air Stream
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.duration: until the end of your next turn
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You shoot out a high-speed blast of air that propels you into the air.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You shoot out a high-speed blast of air that propels you into the air. Make a ranged spell attack against a target's AC. On a success, the target takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage (or double damage on a critical hit). Regardless of whether you hit, you gain a fly Speed of 15 feet until the end of your next turn.

Spell Effect: Propelling Air Stream

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Propelling Air Stream

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Quick Sort
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.targets: up to 200 unattended objects in range, each of light Bulk or less
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You magically sort a group of objects into neat stacks or piles.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You magically sort a group of objects into neat stacks or piles. You can sort the objects in two different ways. The first option is to separate them into different piles depending on an easily observed factor, such as color or shape. Alternatively, you can sort the objects into ordered stacks depending on a clearly indicated notation, such as a page number, title, or date. The objects sort themselves throughout the duration, though it takes less time per object to sort a smaller number of objects, down to a single round for 30 or fewer objects.

**Heightened (3rd)** The spell can sort up to 500 objects in a minute, or 75 objects in a round.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Rainbow's End
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.traits: rare, concentrate, light, manipulate, mythic, spirit
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You reach upward to wrest down a rainbow and harness its power to connect this world to the heavens.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You reach upward to wrest down a rainbow and harness its power to connect this world to the heavens. Each creature in the area takes 1d4 spirit damage with a basic Fortitude save. Any creature that fails this save is additionally dazzled for 1 round. For the spell's duration, an ally who's adjacent to you can Interact and be instantly teleported to an unoccupied space in the spell's area, as long as they don't travel more than 60 feet. This effect has the teleportation trait.

**Heightened (+2)** The damage increases by 2d4, the duration of the dazzled condition on a failed save increases by 1 round, and the maximum distance an ally can use the rainbow to teleport increases by 10 feet.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: War of Immortals — Spells: Rainbow's End

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Restyle
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.targets: 1 piece of clothing currently worn by you or an ally
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You permanently change the appearance of one piece of clothing currently worn by you or an ally to better fit your aesthetic sensibilities.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description: You permanently change the appearance of one piece of clothing currently worn by you or an ally to better fit your aesthetic sensibilities. You can change its color, texture, pattern, and other minor parts of its design, but the changes can't alter the clothing's overall shape, size, or purpose. The changes can't increase the quality of the craftsmanship or artistry of the piece of clothing, but particularly gauche choices for the new color and pattern might decrease its aesthetic appeal. This spell transforms existing materials into the desired appearance and never alters the material or creates more material than what's originally part of the object. The object's statistics also remain unchanged.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Sacred Beasts
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You call out to the creatures of the wild favored by your deity.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
**Requirements** You worship a deity.

You call out to the creatures of the wild favored by your deity. You quickly summon your deity's sacred animal (or a small swarm of them if the animal is usually Tiny). If your deity doesn't have a known sacred animal, work with the GM to find a thematic one. The animal or swarm assaults all creatures in the area, dealing 2d6 damage. The damage is either bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing based on the animal that was conjured, as determined by the GM. After their attacks, the animals return to your deity's plane.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: Howl of the Wild — Spells: Sacred Beasts

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Seashell of Stolen Sound
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You store a sound in a seashell to use as you will: the last words of a loved one, a dragon's mighty roar, the compromising conversation between two powerful diplomats, or even something stranger…
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
**Trigger** A creature within range begins to make a sound.

You store a sound in a seashell to use as you will: the last words of a loved one, a dragon's mighty roar, the compromising conversation between two powerful diplomats, or even something stranger and secret. As part of Casting this Spell, you must present an unbroken seashell. When you Cast the Spell, magic swirls around the triggering creature, copying the sounds it makes, as well as any background noise, for the next minute and storing them in the seashell.

You or another creature can then play the sound back from the seashell during the spell's duration by Interacting with the seashell, but once the sounds have been played back, the seashell shatters, and the spell ends.

As normal for spells with a duration until your next daily preparations, you can choose to continue expending the spell slot to prolong the duration of an existing seashell of stolen sound for another day. While the spell faithfully copies the sounds around the target, it doesn't reproduce any special auditory or sonic effects of the sound.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Seashell of Stolen Sound

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Sky Sight
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You gaze up and see the sky clearly despite environmental conditions.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description: You gaze up and see the sky clearly despite environmental conditions. You can see through weather and physical obstructions such as a forest canopy, building material, and cave walls. This can be used to spot flying creatures or navigate by the stars even when you otherwise couldn't see them.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Stick On
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: The skin on your hand begins to ooze a strange adhesive that causes it to stick to a target.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description: The skin on your hand begins to ooze a strange adhesive that causes it to stick to a target. You and the target become inseparable for the spell's duration or until the target Escapes. If the creature is smaller than you, it's immobilized and pulled along with you as you move. If the target is the same size as you, you're both pulled along with each other as either moves, but you both treat all spaces as difficult terrain. If the target is larger than you, you're immobilized and pulled along as the target moves. You can Dismiss this spell.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Synchronize
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You harmlessly place your unique magic sigil in the shape of your choice, which is about 1 square inch in size, on your targets.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You harmlessly place your unique magic sigil in the shape of your choice, which is about 1 square inch in size, on your targets. When you Cast the Spell, you set the duration by choosing a time at which point the sigil flashes dimly three times. After that point, the spell ends. Even though spell durations aren't normally exact, the effects of *synchronize* are precise to the second. The timer is based on the place where the spell was cast, so entering a plane or area where time flows differently changes how the time elapses in sometimes unpredictable ways.

**Heightened (2nd)** The spell can target up to 20 willing creatures.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Thicket of Knives
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You create numerous phantom copies of your weapon arm, hiding your true movements and rendering your attacks unpredictable.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You create numerous phantom copies of your weapon arm, hiding your true movements and rendering your attacks unpredictable. You gain a +2 status bonus to Deception checks. If you're untrained in Deception, you can use the Feint action anyway as well as add your level as your proficiency bonus despite being untrained.

Spell Effect: Thicket of Knives
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Thicket of Knives

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Albatross Curse
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You create a spectral albatross, a guiding bird for sailors, to hover around the target.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You create a spectral albatross, a guiding bird for sailors, to hover around the target. You and allies within 30 feet of the target gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attacks against the target. The target creature can spend an action to Strike the albatross, which automatically succeeds and kills it. The target must then attempt a Will save against your spell DC.

Spell Effect: Albatross Curse

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The guilt of slaughtering a bird of good fortune weighs on the target's mind. The target is Stupefied 1 for 1 round.

**Failure** The albatross hangs around a cord from the target's neck (or closest equivalent) for 1 minute, cursing them for their transgression. During this time, the target must roll twice and take the worse result on their next Will save, after which the albatross disappears.

Spell Effect: Albatross Curse (Failure)

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the duration is 1 hour.

Spell Effect: Albatross Curse (Critical Failure)
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: Howl of the Wild — Spells: Albatross Curse

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Ash Cloud
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You summon a tumultuous cloud of ash and smoke.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You summon a tumultuous cloud of ash and smoke. The cloud is difficult terrain for flying creatures, and creatures in the cloud can't detect anything using their sense of smell. Creatures that start their turn within the cloud take 2d4 fire damage as their lungs fill with the hot, acrid smoke, with a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes half damage.

**Failure** The target takes full damage and is dazzled for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The target takes double damage and is blinded for 1 round.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d4.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Banishing Touch
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: Your touch projects a surge of magic that launches your target safely away.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
Your touch projects a surge of magic that launches your target safely away. Make a melee spell attack at mythic proficiency against your target's AC. If you hit, you deal 1d6 bludgeoning damage, and you launch the target into the air and away from you; the target takes falling damage as normal. The number of actions you spend while Casting the Spell determines the damage dealt by your touch and how far the target is launched.

◆ The target is launched 10 feet into the air and knocked back 10 feet.

◆◆ Your touch deals 2d6 bludgeoning damage instead. The target is launched 20 feet into the air and pushed back 10 feet.

◆◆◆ Your touch deals 2d6 bludgeoning damage instead. The target is launched 30 feet into the air and pushed back 20 feet.

**Heightened (4th)** The initial damage increases by 1d6, and all distances increase by 10 feet for the 1-action version or 20 feet for the 2- and 3-action versions.

**Heightened (6th)** The initial damage increases by 2d6, and all distances increase by 20 feet for the 1-action version or 60 feet for the 2- and 3-action versions.

**Heightened (8th)** The initial damage increases by 3d6, and all distances increase by 30 feet for the 1-action version or 100 feet for the 2- and 3-action versions.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: War of Immortals — Spells: Banishing Touch

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Befitting Attire
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You cloak the targets in an illusion, shaping their clothing and worn items into ones suitable for a particular occasion.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You cloak the targets in an illusion, shaping their clothing and worn items into ones suitable for a particular occasion. You visualize the occasion, and the spell creates illusory attire customized to each target. For instance, if you visualized a noble ball, armor would appear to be fine clothing. This doesn't change identifying details of the targets' appearances other than their clothes.

Any creature that touches the attire, uses the Seek action to examine it, or otherwise interacts with it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

**Heightened (4th)** You can target up to 20 creatures.

**Heightened (5th)** You can target up to 100 creatures.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Blood Runs Cold
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You chill the blood in the target's veins.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You chill the blood in the target's veins. The target takes 1d6 persistent cold damage with a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes half the persistent cold damage.

**Failure** The target takes the full persistent cold damage and is Slowed 1 for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The target takes double the persistent cold damage and is slowed 1 until the persistent cold damage ends.

**Heightened (+2)** Increase the persistent cold damage by 1d6.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Blood Runs Cold

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Bone Spray
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You fire a torrent of jagged bone shards from your hands that rips through the fleshy bodies of your enemies.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You fire a torrent of jagged bone shards from your hands that rips through the fleshy bodies of your enemies. The spray deals 2d10 piercing damage and 1 persistent bleed damage to all creatures in the area, with a basic Reflex save.

**Heightened (+1)** The piercing damage increases by 1d10, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Claws of the Otter
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: Webbing grows between your fingers and your nails extend into vicious claws.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
Webbing grows between your fingers and your nails extend into vicious claws. For the spell's duration, you gain a +1 status bonus to Athletics checks to Swim and you gain a claws unarmed attack. They're an agile, finesse, unarmed attack that deals 1d4 slashing damage and an additional 1d6 cold damage.

Spell Effect: Claws of the Otter

**Heightened (+3)** The additional cold damage increases by 1d6.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: Howl of the Wild — Spells: Claws of the Otter

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Dancing Shield
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.targets: 1 touched shield (unattended or in your possession) and 1 willing creature
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You levitate the touched shield and send it to orbit around a creature.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You levitate the touched shield and send it to orbit around a creature. When you Cast the Spell and Sustain it, the shield uses the Raise a Shield action to protect the target creature.

Spell Effect: Dancing Shield

**Heightened (4th)** If you have the Shield Block reaction, you can use your reaction to have the target shield use Shield Block when the target creature would take damage from a physical attack, in addition to the usual trigger. In this case, Shield Block protects the target creature, rather than you. Since the shield is using Shield Block and not you, additional effects or abilities that normally apply when you Shield Block don't apply.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Dimensional Drop
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You place a portal on the ground directly beneath a creature.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You place a portal on the ground directly beneath a creature. That target immediately plummets into extradimensional space, falling a distance through an infinite, featureless void before being forcibly ejected from a portal that appears right above their original space and taking the appropriate fall damage. The target must attempt a Reflex saving throw. The DC to Arrest a Fall is equal to your spell DC.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target falls 10 feet through the void before reappearing.

**Failure** The target falls 20 feet through the void before reappearing.

**Critical Failure** The target falls 40 feet through the void before reappearing.

**Heightened (5th)** You can target up to 5 creatures within range.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Disintegrating Puddle
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You spit out a green glob of dangerous acid that increases in size as it flies at the target, splashing around them as it hits them.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You spit out a green glob of dangerous acid that increases in size as it flies at the target, splashing around them as it hits them. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a success, the target takes 2d12 acid damage, and acid splatters to the ground in the target's space and all spaces adjacent to the target. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage. The acid puddle lasts for 1 minute; a creature that enters or starts its turn in the acid puddle takes (1d4 per 2 levels) acid damage.

**Heightened (+2)** The initial acid damage increases by 2d12, and the acid puddle damage increases by 1d4.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Disorienting Flash
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You create a small explosion of bright light and ear-piercing sound that rocks the senses.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You create a small explosion of bright light and ear-piercing sound that rocks the senses. Creatures in the area take sonic damage with a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines the damage and other parameters.

◆ This spell deals 1d10 sonic damage, and its area is a 5-foot square. Creatures that fail their save become dazzled until the end of your next turn.

◆◆ This spell deals 2d10 sonic damage, and its area is a 10-foot burst. Creatures that fail their save become dazzled until the end of your next turn.

◆◆◆ This spell deals 2d10 sonic damage, and its area is a 20-foot burst. Creatures that fail their save become dazzled and deafened until the end of your next turn.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d10 for all versions.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Draw Blood
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: The palm of your hand grows a mouth with impossibly long fangs that ache to drink your enemies' blood.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
The palm of your hand grows a mouth with impossibly long fangs that ache to drink your enemies' blood. Make a melee spell attack against a target. On a hit, you deal 4d4 piercing damage and 2 persistent bleed damage (or double damage on a critical hit). For the duration of the spell, you regain level-based Hit Points each time the target takes bleed damage.

**Heightened (+1)** The piercing damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage and healing increase by 1.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Electrostatic Glider
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You generate an arc of static electricity above you, allowing you to ride air currents and descend gracefully, though it doesn't provide actual flight.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description: You generate an arc of static electricity above you, allowing you to ride air currents and descend gracefully, though it doesn't provide actual flight. During this spell's duration, you can glide as a single action that has the move trait. When you glide, you move 5 feet down and 25 feet through the air, though you can control the direction you travel. As long as you spend at least 1 action gliding each round and haven't yet reached the ground, you remain in the air at the end of your turn. At the GM's discretion, strong winds might affect your movements. If the spell ends while you're in the air, you fall normally.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Elemental Zone
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: Select an elemental trait: air, earth, fire, metal, water, or wood.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
Select an elemental trait: air, earth, fire, metal, water, or wood. *Elemental zone* gains the trait you chose. You imbue the area with the raw energy of that element, creating a zone that emits and amplifies magic of that type. The temperature might suddenly rise or fall, a storm cloud might form, and so on. Spells with the chosen elemental trait cast against creatures in the zone get a +2 status bonus to one damage type the spell deals based on the chosen trait: bludgeoning or electricity for air, bludgeoning for earth, fire for fire, electricity or slashing for metal, bludgeoning or cold for water, and bludgeoning or vitality for wood. The caster chooses one type to add the bonus to if the spell deals more than one eligible type. This bonus is halved if the spell didn't use a spell slot (such as a cantrip, focus spell, or innate spell).

The zone has no effect on the spell if the spell doesn't deal any damage of an eligible type.

**Heightened (+2)** The status bonus increases by 1.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Empty Pack
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You render every item inside the container you touch invisible, although the container itself remains visible.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You render every item inside the container you touch invisible, although the container itself remains visible. The items within are undetected to all creatures, though a creature can attempt to find an item by reaching into the bag, making an item hidden to them instead if they succeed. Additionally, the spell doesn't prevent the items from making protrusions in the bag, adding weight, making noise when jostling around, and so on. However, the spell prevents anything within the container from falling out if it's upended. Any object removed from the container becomes visible and remains visible even if returned to the container.

**Heightened (4th)** The duration is until the next time you make your daily preparations.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Explosive Dust
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You scatter a cloud of highly explosive magic dust into the air near you that only those who mean you harm can ignite.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You scatter a cloud of highly explosive magic dust into the air near you that only those who mean you harm can ignite. This dust is hard to see, requiring a Seek roll against your spell DC to identify. You and your allies can pass through it safely, but enemies who move into the dust trigger explosions, taking 1d4 fire damage for every square they pass through. Once the dust in a square explodes, that square becomes safe for everyone. If all the dust explodes, the spell ends.

**Heightened (+2)** The damage an enemy takes by passing through a square increase by 1d4.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Familiar's Resurrection
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.targets: your dead familiar of 4th level or lower
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: Raising the dead is usually a complex and sophisticated magic, not to mention an expensive one.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
Raising the dead is usually a complex and sophisticated magic, not to mention an expensive one. Familiars, however, are creatures with strange souls, bound to their masters. You can channel this connection to resurrect a familiar. Your familiar returns to life with 1 Hit Point.

**Heightened (+1)** The maximum level of a familiar you can resurrect with this spell increases by 2.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Far-Flung Fetch
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.targets: 1 unattended object of light Bulk or less
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You can pilfer an object even if it's outside the reach of your fingers.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You can pilfer an object even if it's outside the reach of your fingers. You teleport the target into one of your open hands. If you don't have a hand free, it falls to the ground at your feet.

**Heightened (3rd)** The range increases to 120 feet.

**Heightened (5th)** The range increases to 120 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

**Heightened (7th)** As 5th rank, and when you Cast the Spell you can spend 3 actions instead of 1 to increase the range to planetary. If you do, you don't need line of sight to the target, but you must be extremely familiar with the target.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Feral Shades
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: A wave of gray mist formed of energy from the Void spills out from your outstretched hand, briefly taking the shape of a pack of predatory animals that set viciously on your foes.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
A wave of gray mist formed of energy from the Void spills out from your outstretched hand, briefly taking the shape of a pack of predatory animals that set viciously on your foes. You deal 2d4 slashing damage and 2d4 void damage to creatures in the area, with a basic Fortitude save. The shades set upon the vulnerable with greater ferocity: prone creatures or those taking persistent bleed damage take a –2 status penalty to the save.

**Heightened (+1)** The slashing damage and the void damage each increase by 1d4.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Flame Wisp
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: Three faintly glowing wisps of fire float around your head, dancing along to your movements.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
Three faintly glowing wisps of fire float around your head, dancing along to your movements. After you deal damage to a creature with a Strike, one of the wisps goes hurtling toward that creature, destroying the wisp and dealing 1d4 fire damage. If you Cast a Spell with the fire trait while you have fewer than three wisps, a new wisp appears.

Spell Effect: Flame Wisp

**Heightened (+2)** The damage increases by 1d4.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Floating Harness
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: The target is supported by a magical harness that keeps it next to you wherever you may go.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
The target is supported by a magical harness that keeps it next to you wherever you may go. The target remains adjacent to you, regardless of your form of movement, even if they wouldn't typically have that form of movement, such as flying, climbing, or swimming. The target can't move to a space that isn't adjacent to you while the spell is active. If forced movement causes either of you to no longer be adjacent to each other, the spell ends. You can Dismiss this spell.

**Heightened (4th)** The duration increases to 8 hours.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Frog Tongue
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: Your tongue extends unnaturally, flicking out toward a creature within range and dealing 2d8 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex save).
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
Your tongue extends unnaturally, flicking out toward a creature within range and dealing 2d8 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex save). On a failure, the creature is also stuck to the end of the tongue. It is off-guard and can't move beyond the reach of your tongue. A creature can sever the tongue with a Strike that deals at least 10 slashing damage or attempt to Escape against your spell DC. The AC of the tongue is equal to your spell DC. Severing the tongue in this way deals no damage to you but ends the spell. While a creature is stuck to the end of your tongue, actions you take with the auditory trait take a –2 circumstance penalty. If you move so that the affected creature is outside of the tongue's reach, the spell ends.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d8.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: Howl of the Wild — Spells: Frog Tongue

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Frozen Lungs
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: Pulling at the molecules of water that help create life, you rearrange them to help end it.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
Pulling at the molecules of water that help create life, you rearrange them to help end it. Freezing cold water pools within the lungs of the target, dealing 2d8 cold damage with a Fortitude save. You can Dismiss this spell.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes half damage. For the spell's duration, the target takes 1 cold damage whenever it performs an auditory action or Casts a Spell.

**Failure** The target takes full damage. For the spell's duration, the target takes (1d8 per 2 levels) cold damage whenever it performs an auditory action or Casts a Spell.

**Critical Failure** The target takes double damage. For the spell's duration, the target takes level-based cold damage whenever it performs an auditory action or Casts a Spell.

**Heightened (+2)** The initial cold damage increases by 2d8, and on a failure or critical failure, the cold damage whenever the target performs an auditory action or Casts a Spell increases by 1d8.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Glacial Causeway
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You create a path of ice that begins beneath your feet and extends up to 120 feet in a straight line, starting from you.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description: You create a path of ice that begins beneath your feet and extends up to 120 feet in a straight line, starting from you. When you end your turn on the path, you gain the quickened condition until the end of your next turn and can use the extra action only to Stride. Other creatures treat the path as difficult terrain.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Guiding Star
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: Using mystical magic, you call on the constellations of the night sky to guide a creature to the location where you've Cast the Spell.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description: Using mystical magic, you call on the constellations of the night sky to guide a creature to the location where you've Cast the Spell. Each time the target views the stars, it receives a mental nudge toward your chosen location, though it isn't compelled to follow. The target can recognize you as the source. If the creature goes to another planet or plane, the spell's effects are suppressed, but they resume if the creature returns.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Helpful Reload
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: With a quick gesture, you reload your ally's weapon, allowing them to focus on fighting the enemy.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
**Trigger** One of your allies makes a ranged Strike with a weapon with a reload of 1 or less

**Requirements** Your ally has more ammunition for their ranged weapon available.

With a quick gesture, you reload your ally's weapon, allowing them to focus on fighting the enemy. You reload their weapon with a piece of mundane ammunition from the triggering creature's inventory.

**Heightened (4th)** You reload your ally's weapon and grant them a +1 status bonus to their next Strike with this weapon.

Spell Effect: Helpful Reload

**Heightened (6th)** You reload your ally's weapon with the ammunition of their choice from their inventory. Your ally gains a +1 status bonus to their next Strike with this weapon.

**Heightened (8th)** The spell no longer requires your ally to have appropriate ammunition available. You summon a single piece of common magical ammunition of 10th level or lower to reload your ally's weapon with. Your ally gains a +1 status bonus to their next Strike with this weapon.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Helpful Scribe
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You conjure a magical floating quill to assist in copying the text from one non-magical piece of literature to a blank page or empty book in your possession.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description: You conjure a magical floating quill to assist in copying the text from one non-magical piece of literature to a blank page or empty book in your possession. You first press your finger to the page you want copied, then to the blank page, and the quill sets to work, magically conjuring ink as it writes. It can't translate languages, codes, or idioms, but it transcribes the text exactly as-is from one page to the other. The quill can copy roughly one average book page per minute and disappears when the spell is finished.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Hidebound
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.requirements: A creature within range is hit with a Strike that deals physical damage.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: The target's skin erupts in thick hide or dense scales.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
**Trigger** A creature within range is hit with a Strike that deals physical damage.

The target's skin erupts in thick hide or dense scales. It gains resistance 5 to physical damage, except adamantine, until the beginning of its next turn.

Spell Effect: Hidebound

**Heightened (+2)** The resistance increases by 3.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: Howl of the Wild — Spells: Hidebound

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Ignite Fireworks
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: A brilliant and clamorous display of sparks and colorful fireworks explode around your enemies, dealing 1d8 fire damage and 1d8 sonic damage to creatures within a 10-foot burst.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
A brilliant and clamorous display of sparks and colorful fireworks explode around your enemies, dealing 1d8 fire damage and 1d8 sonic damage to creatures within a 10-foot burst. All creatures in the area must attempt a Reflex save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage and is dazzled for 1 round.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and is dazzled for 3 rounds.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage, takes 1d4 persistent fire damage, and is dazzled for 1 minute.

**Heightened (+2)** The initial fire damage increases by 1d8, the sonic damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent fire damage a creature takes on a critical failure increases by 1d4.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Imprinting Hand
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: Your hand presses into your target, leaving an imprint on its body.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
Your hand presses into your target, leaving an imprint on its body. The target takes 8 force damage with a Fortitude save. The first time within the next minute the target's Hit Points are restored by a healing effect, that healing is reduced by 8. After any amount of healing is reduced, the spell ends.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes half the force damage and half the healing reduction.

**Failure** The target takes the full force damage and the full healing reduction.

**Critical Failure** The target takes double the damage and double the healing reduction.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage and healing reduction both increase by 4.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Inner Radiance Torrent
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You gradually merge several kinds of energy into your cupped hands before firing off a storm of bolts and beams that deal 4d4 force damage to all creatures in a 60-foot line.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You gradually merge several kinds of energy into your cupped hands before firing off a storm of bolts and beams that deal 4d4 force damage to all creatures in a 60-foot line. Creatures in the area must attempt a basic Reflex save. On a critical failure, they're also blinded for 1 round. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines the area. If the line passes through an area of magical darkness or targets a creature affected by magical darkness, *inner radiance torrent* attempts to counteract the darkness.

◆◆ The line is 60 feet long.

◆◆◆ The line is 120 feet long.

**Two Rounds** If you spend 3 actions casting the spell, you can avoid finishing the spell and spend another 2 actions on your next turn to empower the spell even further. You can take other actions before finishing this spell, but the spell is lost if you Cast another Spell in between. The line is 120 feet long, the damage dealt by this spell increases by 4d4, and you enter a shining state for 1 minute, causing you to glow with light and deal level-based force damage to creatures that end their turn adjacent to you.

**Heightened (+1)** The initial damage, as well as the additional damage for the 2-round casting time, each increase by 2d4, and the damage to adjacent creatures dealt while in your shining state increases by 1.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Inner Radiance Torrent

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Lock Item
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.targets: 1 object held by 1 creature and the creature holding it
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: One object held by a creature becomes fused to that creature's hand and can't be put down.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
One object held by a creature becomes fused to that creature's hand and can't be put down. To Disarm or Steal the item, the result of the skill check must exceed the spell's DC or the normal DC, whichever is higher. To voluntarily drop the weapon, the target must spend an Interact action rather than a free action, and then succeed at a Reflex save; the target must also attempt a Reflex save to Interact to put away or swap the object. On a failed save, the action is wasted, but on a success, they drop the item and the spell ends. An unwilling creature must attempt an initial Reflex save against lock item. A willing creature can choose to critically fail the saving throw.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is affected for 1 round.

**Failure** The creature is affected for 4 rounds.

**Critical Failure** The creature is affected for 1 minute.

**Heightened (+2)** You can target either one additional object held by the same creature or one additional object held by one additional creature.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Loose Time's Arrow
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.duration: until the end of your next turn
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You pluck the time stream like a bow—pull one string back, release, and watch a creature fly.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description: You pluck the time stream like a bow—pull one string back, release, and watch a creature fly. All affected targets are quickened. They can use the extra action only to Step or Stride.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Spells: Loose Time's Arrow

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Lucky Number
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.duration: until the next time you make your daily preparations
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: When you Cast this Spell, roll 1d10 and make a note of the result; this is your lucky number for the duration.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
When you Cast this Spell, roll 1d10 and make a note of the result; this is your lucky number for the duration. You gain the That's My Number reaction. Once you use the reaction, the spell ends, and you become temporarily immune to *lucky number* until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Spell Effect: Lucky Number

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Metal Reverberation
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You conjure a metal tuning fork and strike it, the vibration creating a soft ping that rattles the foundations of the target.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You conjure a metal tuning fork and strike it, the vibration creating a soft ping that rattles the foundations of the target. Whenever you Cast this Spell and the first time you sustain it on subsequent turns, the target object produces the same note in an ear-piercing frequency that deals 1d12 sonic damage to all creatures in its space and all adjacent spaces (basic Fortitude save).

**Heightened (+2)** The damage increases by 1d12.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Mist Sight
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You enhance the eyes of the target, allowing them to see through fog, smoke, or vapor in a 10-foot emanation from themself; they ignore concealment from such effects in the area.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You enhance the eyes of the target, allowing them to see through fog, smoke, or vapor in a 10-foot emanation from themself; they ignore concealment from such effects in the area. This doesn't prevent them from experiencing adverse effects from poisons or particulates in the air within the area.

**Heightened (4th)** You target up to four willing creatures within 30 feet.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Murder of Crows
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You send out a flock of crows that torments the target with beak and talon.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You send out a flock of crows that torments the target with beak and talon. Make a ranged spell attack against a target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 6d4 piercing damage and is dazzled for 1 round (double damage and blinded for 1 round on a critical hit).

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 3d4.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Murder of Crows

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Palm-Held Sun
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You open a rift into the plane of creation, igniting it into a miniature star that blazes with mighty light.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You open a rift into the plane of creation, igniting it into a miniature star that blazes with mighty light. You shed bright light in a 30-foot emanation (and dim light to the next 30 feet). When you Cast or Sustain the spell, each creature with void healing in the aura takes 1 vitality damage, and any creature in the aura with a particular vulnerability to sunlight becomes Slowed 1 for 1 round unless it succeeds at a Fortitude save. After a creature in the aura loses HP due to fire damage from any source, it takes 1 vitality damage.

Spell Effect: Palm-Held Sun

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Persistent Servant
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You call forth a Phantasmal Minion and task it to perform a specific chore repeatedly.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You call forth a Phantasmal Minion and task it to perform a specific chore repeatedly. Choose a basic instruction, such as sweeping the floor, or picking up all objects from the floor and putting them in a designated bin. The servant performs the task over and over again throughout the duration, though it can't ever leave the spell's area.

The servant isn't a minion, and you don't need to Sustain the Spell in order for it to continue to act. However, it acts on its own time, and thus can't accomplish anything useful during an encounter, even if an encounter happens within the spell's range.

Tasks that rely on timing, discretion, or significant manual dexterity are doomed to failure. For instance, a servant tasked to pick objects off the floor won't discriminate between trash, misplaced treasure, or objects that are supposed to be on the floor, like a mousetrap.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Phantom Crowd
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: A tightly packed crowd of humanoids appropriate to the area appear, facing you and agreeing loudly with anything you say.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
A tightly packed crowd of humanoids appropriate to the area appear, facing you and agreeing loudly with anything you say. A creature that touches a member of the crowd or makes a Seek action to examine the crowd can attempt to disbelieve your illusion. The crowd is difficult terrain for anyone who hasn't disbelieved the illusion.
