When you spend 1 or more actions to cast a Composition Spell or to perform an activity that includes a Performance check, you can also Sustain this Spell as part of that action.

**Heightened (+1)** The crowd occupies an additional 10-foot square in range. The additional square doesn't need to be adjacent to any other square created by the spell. It can overlap, but there's no additional effect in the overlapped squares.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Retrieving Hook
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.targets: 1 creature or an undattended object of 2 Bulk or less
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You conjure a magical hook and rope that hurtles toward the target and pulls them to you.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You conjure a magical hook and rope that hurtles toward the target and pulls them to you. The target must attempt a Fortitude save. If the target is a willing ally or unattended object, they automatically fail the save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is pulled 5 feet toward you.

**Failure** The target is pulled to the nearest empty space adjacent to you.

**Critical Failure** As failure, and the target is off-guard for 1 round.

**Heightened (5th)** The range increases to 30 feet.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Shift Perspective
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You throw one item of light Bulk or less that you're holding to a location within range that you can see, then gain temporary vision from where that object lands.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description: You throw one item of light Bulk or less that you're holding to a location within range that you can see, then gain temporary vision from where that object lands. The object sees in all directions with your normal visual senses. You can Sustain this spell to switch between the thrown object's perspective and your regular vision while the spell is active, but you can only see through one perspective at a time. You can Dismiss this spell.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Sonata Span
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: By playing a brief tune on an instrument or in song, you cause the notes of the melody to physically manifest into a shimmering, translucent path.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description: By playing a brief tune on an instrument or in song, you cause the notes of the melody to physically manifest into a shimmering, translucent path. This path doesn't need to be over solid ground and can tilt up or down diagonally up to 45 degrees, but it must be a straight, 5-foot-wide line. It can support as many creatures as can physically fit on the bridge.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Steel Fortifications
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You conjure several metal structures that consist of angled beams attached to one another at a central point, which can help block attacks.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You conjure several metal structures that consist of angled beams attached to one another at a central point, which can help block attacks. You creature up to three Large structures within range in unoccupied squares; each fortification is 8 feet long, 8 feet wide, and 8 feet tall. There must be enough room for a fortification in order to conjure it. A single fortification has an AC of 10 and is immune to critical hits and precision damage. It has Hardness 9, 60 Hit Points, and a BT of 30. Once a fortification is broken, it crumbles into sharp metal bits. Any creature adjacent to or sharing a space with a fortification when it is broken must attempt a Reflex save or take 2d6 persistent bleed damage.

Creatures can pass through the spaces of a fortification, though Medium and larger creatures treat these spaces as difficult terrain. A Small or smaller creature can occupy the same spaces as a fortification; doing so grants them standard cover. Similarly, a prone Medium creature can occupy the same spaces as a fortification, gaining standard cover in the process. A Medium or smaller creature can climb a fortification with a successful DC 15 Athletics check.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Sticky Fire
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You send a bubble of viscous liquid that sparks into flame.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You send a bubble of viscous liquid that sparks into flame. Make a spell attack roll against the target's AC, dealing 1d8 fire damage and 1d8 persistent fire damage on a hit. The target is Enfeebled 1 until they recover from their persistent fire damage.

**Heightened (+2)** The initial and persistent fire damage increase by 1d8.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Summoner's Precaution
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: Conjuring and intricate weave of protective magic, you create a buffer in the link between yourself and your eidolon, allowing your bonded ally to sacrifice their existence to save you in a time of…
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description: Conjuring and intricate weave of protective magic, you create a buffer in the link between yourself and your eidolon, allowing your bonded ally to sacrifice their existence to save you in a time of need. You gain the Sever Conduit reaction; after using it, the spell ends.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Summoner's Visage
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: No one understands you more than your eidolon and vice versa.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
No one understands you more than your eidolon and vice versa. Using this innate understanding, you transform your eidolon into your identical twin, allowing them to hide their presence or impersonate you to a limited extent. Assuming you are a humanoid, the eidolon gains the humanoid trait in addition to its other traits while it's in this form, as well as any other trait related to your form (such as elf or gnome). Your eidolon gains a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to Impersonate you and can add its level to such checks even if it's untrained.

Although your eidolon looks like you, it doesn't gain any new abilities, and its statistics don't change in any way-the transformation is purely cosmetic. If this transformation reduces your eidolon's size, the eidolon loses any other effects of its larger size, such as any increase to reach. Your eidolon can still use gear only if it has the eidolon trait, which allows eidolons to use it. If necessary, any such eidolon items the eidolon was wearing remain active but change size and shape to reflect what you're wearing.

You can Dismiss the spell to return your eidolon to their original form.

Spell Effect: Summoner's Visage

**Heightened (4th)** The duration increases to 1 hour.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Tacky Pine Sap
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You conjure highly flammable pine sap, covering the area with it.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You conjure highly flammable pine sap, covering the area with it. This area becomes difficult terrain. When a creature within the area uses a fire effect or receives fire damage, the sap ignites, dealing (1d6 per 2 levels) persistent fire damage to anyone standing on it; this burns up the sap, removing it and its difficult terrain.

**Heightened (+2)** The persistent fire damage increases by 1d6.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Tacky Pine Sap

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Thunder Echo
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: With a clap of your hands, you emit a loud but harmless burst of electricity, interpreting the discharged electrostatic sparks to navigate the area and help reveal secrets.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description: With a clap of your hands, you emit a loud but harmless burst of electricity, interpreting the discharged electrostatic sparks to navigate the area and help reveal secrets. Hidden chambers, objects, and creatures within the area of the effect become easier to find as they spark with static electricity, causing all creatures to gain a +2 status bonus to Perception checks to locate them for the duration. The area of effect is unimpeded by walls and solid objects.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Thundering Dominance
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You shroud the target in a powerful predatory aura and amplify its vocalizations.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You shroud the target in a powerful predatory aura and amplify its vocalizations. It gains a +1 status bonus to Intimidation checks. Once during this spell's duration, it can take the Thundering Roar action.

Spell Effect: Thundering Dominance

**Heightened (+2)** The status bonus to Intimidation checks increases by 1 (to a maximum of a +4 status bonus for an 8th-rank spell), and the damage from the roar increases by 2d8.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Timely Reminder
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You send a message to yourself that's delivered at a delayed time of your choosing.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You send a message to yourself that's delivered at a delayed time of your choosing. Whisper a message no longer than 8 words and concentrate on a date and time within the next year. At the chosen moment, a gentle chime will sound in your head, followed by the message repeated twice in an average, steady tone. This spell can be Dismissed at any time. If a new casting of timely reminder is used, the first message is erased as soon as the new message is created.

**Heightened (5th)** You send the reminder message to another willing creature you know. If the creature isn't on the same plane of existence when you Cast this Spell, the spell fails.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Timely Tutor
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You serve as an astral connection between your eidolon or familiar and the Akashic Record—a demiplane consisting of a comprehensive psychic library.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
You serve as an astral connection between your eidolon or familiar and the Akashic Record—a demiplane consisting of a comprehensive psychic library. If you Cast this Spell on your familiar, your familiar adds your spellcasting attribute modifier on checks to Recall Knowledge with the Lore skill of your choice, much like they do for Acrobatics and Stealth. Your familiar must have the speech familiar ability in order to share any information they learn with you. If you Cast this Spell on your eidolon, they instead become trained in the Lore skill of your choice.

If you lose physical contact with the target, their connection to the Akashic Record is severed, and the spell immediately ends.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Tracing Bond
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You and an ally might be parting ways, but you know that you'll continue to have each other's backs.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description: You and an ally might be parting ways, but you know that you'll continue to have each other's backs. For the duration of the spell, you and the ally always know the direction and distance to the other's location as long as you're both on the same plane of existence. While this bond doesn't allow you to send messages or generally know the other person's status, at any point during the spell, either of you can send a single distress signal to the other as a single action that has the concentrate and mental traits. This signal is a simple mental alert that doesn't provide any additional details about the situation or status of the person. Once this signal has been used, neither target can send another signal for the duration of the spell.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Uncover Device
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You focus on the construction of the object, channeling electricity through it that allows you to get a sense of its shape and construction.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description: You focus on the construction of the object, channeling electricity through it that allows you to get a sense of its shape and construction. You gain a +2 status bonus to Thievery checks to Disable Device on the target and to Aid checks to help an ally Disable Devise on the target.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Unrelenting Gravity
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: Even the fundamental forces of the universe can bend to your magic and submit to your will.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
Even the fundamental forces of the universe can bend to your magic and submit to your will. You create an isolated but powerful downward force by greatly increasing the force of gravity your target experiences, hampering its movement and pushing it to the ground. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is encumbered for 1 round.

**Failure** The target falls prone and is encumbered for 1 round. Additionally, if this spell causes the target to fall, the DC to Arrest a Fall is your spell DC.

**Critical Failure** The target falls prone and is encumbered for 1 round. Additionally, if this spell causes the target to fall, the target can't Arrest a Fall, and falling damage is doubled.

**Heightened (4th)** You can target up to five creatures.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Vanish Weapon
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.duration: until the end of your next turn
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: You create a small extradimensional space that you can use to snag weapons.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
**Trigger** A creature succeeds at (but not critically succeeds at) or fails a melee Strike with a weapon targeting you.

You create a small extradimensional space that you can use to snag weapons. You attempt to Disarm the triggering creature using a melee spell attack roll instead of an Athletics check. You don't need a hand free for this attempt. If you successfully knock the weapon from the triggering creature's grasp, it disappears into your extradimensional space. You can Interact to draw the weapon as if you were wearing it; if you do so, the spell ends. If the weapon is still in the extradimensional space when the spell ends, it falls to the ground at your feet. You can Dismiss this spell.

This reaction doesn't prevent damage from a successful Strike.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Warrior's Regret
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: Regret eats away at the target's mind, punishing it for its violence until it ceases its hostility.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description:
Regret eats away at the target's mind, punishing it for its violence until it ceases its hostility. The target must attempt a Will save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** At the end of its next turn, the target takes 1d8 damage per different creature it intentionally damaged on that turn (1d8 if it damaged one creature, 2d8 if it damaged two different creatures, and so on). The maximum is 4d8 if it damaged 4 different creatures.

**Failure** As success, except the curse damages the target at the end of each of its turns and lasts until the target spends a complete round without intentionally damaging another creature.

**Critical Failure** As success, except the curse damages the target at the end of each of its turns and lasts until the target spends 24 hours atoning for its perceived sins.

**Heightened (+2)** The amount of mental damage the target takes for each creature it damaged that turn increases by 1d8, and the maximum damage the target can take per turn increases by 4d8.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.name: Watchdog
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.summary: Your faithful friend stands watch at the entrance when you don't want enemies to take you by surprise.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-1-2.description: Your faithful friend stands watch at the entrance when you don't want enemies to take you by surprise. The target remains at the location, keeping watch for creatures. You must remain within 1 mile of your companion, or the spell ends. When any creature approaches within 30 feet of your companion, you're immediately alerted with the effects of the alarm spell. When this happens, you see the image of whatever creature triggered the alert as your companion would see it. You can Dismiss the spell. When this spell ends, your companion immediately teleports to an unoccupied space closest to you.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Antlion Trap
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You transmute the ground into a conical pit trap of loose sand that becomes difficult terrain for the duration.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You transmute the ground into a conical pit trap of loose sand that becomes difficult terrain for the duration. A creature or unsecured object that enters the sand or starts its turn in the sand is moved toward the center, depending on the result of its Reflex save. This is forced movement. If there isn't enough space near the center of the pit, affected creatures and objects move as far as they can without being blocked, up to the amount set by their saving throw outcomes.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature moves 5 feet toward the center.

**Failure** The creature moves 10 feet toward the center.

**Critical Failure** As failure, and the creature becomes immobilized in the pit. It can attempt to Escape against your spell DC.

**Heightened (+2)** Increase the area of the spell and the amount a creature moves on a failure by 5 feet.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.cite: Howl of the Wild — Spells: Antlion Trap

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Begone
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: With but a touch, a mystical force sends a foe rocketing backward.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
With but a touch, a mystical force sends a foe rocketing backward. The target creature must attempt a Fortitude save. If the creature's movement causes it to hit a firm surface, such as a wall, it takes level-based bludgeoning damage. A creature knocked off a ledge or the like can Grab An Edge to avoid falling.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is pushed 5 feet away from you.

**Failure** The creature is pushed 15 feet away from you.

**Critical Failure** The creature is pushed 30 feet away from you.

**Heightened (+2)** The bludgeoning damage increases by 5.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Behold the Weave
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You behold the many timelines that weave around a creature, and in so doing, you make one more likely to occur.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You behold the many timelines that weave around a creature, and in so doing, you make one more likely to occur. The target must attempt a Will save.

**Critical Success** You can make neither heads nor tails of the target's timeline, and the target is unaffected.

The creature can choose to lock in a 2- or 3-action activity if it prefers to do so, but if it does, it loses all the associated actions if it can't perform the activity on its turn.

All of these actions are similarly locked in and can't be changed, but the creature can take them in any order.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the creature must commit all of its actions for the next turn.

**Heightened (7th)** Instead of affecting a single target, the spell affects all enemies within a 30-foot emanation.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Spells: Behold the Weave

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Blazing Dive
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: Superheated air collects under you, buoying you high into the sky before you plummet back down in a fiery comet.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
Superheated air collects under you, buoying you high into the sky before you plummet back down in a fiery comet. You Fly 15 feet straight up into the air, then Fly in a straight line to an empty space of your choice on the ground within 60 feet. When you land, blistering air blasts out from you, dealing 3d4 bludgeoning damage and 3d6 fire damage (basic Reflex save) to all creatures in a 10-foot emanation.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d4 bludgeoning and 1d6 fire.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Blister Bomb
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You launch a small bomb enchanted with a fast-acting skin disease at your foes, causing their skin to break out in horrible bleeding sores.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You launch a small bomb enchanted with a fast-acting skin disease at your foes, causing their skin to break out in horrible bleeding sores. All creatures in the area of the burst must attempt a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected and is immune to blister pox for 1 week.

**Success** The creature is Sickened 2.

**Failure** The creature is afflicted with blister pox at stage 1.

**Critical Failure** The creature is afflicted with blister pox at stage 2.

**Blister Pox** (disease) Level 5; A creature can't reduce its sickened value below 1 while it's taking persistent bleed damage from blister pox

**Stage 1** sickened 2 (1 round)

**Stage 2** sickened 2 and 1d6 persistent bleed damage (1 round)

**Stage 3** sickened 2 and 2d6 persistent bleed damage (1 round)

**Stage 4** Sickened 3 and 2d6 persistent bleed damage (1 day)

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Bone Moth's Kiss
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.targets: 1 creature with bones or a natural exoskeleton
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: A tiny, bone-white moth emerges from your open mouth.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
A tiny, bone-white moth emerges from your open mouth. It shakes itself off, spreads its wings, and flies toward your foe, brushing its wings against their exposed skin. The moth carries a disease that causes a victim's bones to quickly grow soft and eventually melt. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The moth only briefly brushes its wings against the target. The target is Sickened 1.

**Failure** The moth lands on the target, kissing the spot with its fluttering. The target is afflicted with the bone moth's kiss at stage 1.

**Critical Failure** The moth lands on an open wound, targeting it with its kiss. The target is afflicted with the bone moth's kiss at stage 2.

**Bone Moth's Kiss** (disease)

**Stage 1** Drained 1 and sickened 1 (1 round)

**Stage 2** Drained 2 (1 round)

**Stage 3** Drained 3 and can't recover from the drained condition until the disease is cured (1 day)
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Bone Moth's Kiss

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Bottomless Stomach
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You create a shimmering extradimensional space accessible from the target's mouth.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You create a shimmering extradimensional space accessible from the target's mouth. The space can hold objects and equipment, up to a total of 10 Bulk. This extradimensional storage doesn't hamper the target's ability to eat, drink, speak (if applicable), or otherwise act, as it only opens and closes when the target chooses.

The target can Interact to swallow an object of up to 1 Bulk, which doesn't harm the object or the target. If the extradimensional space is full, the target can't add any more objects until first removing one or more stored objects. Organic matter and living creatures can't be stored in this space. The extradimensional storage is obvious to any creature who looks into the target's mouth, as the entryway shimmers slightly, though this doesn't clearly reveal the contents inside.

The target can Interact to spit out a single object of their choice, causing the object to fall to the ground in the target's space. The target can Interact three times in a row to spit out the entire contents of the extradimensional storage; the target doesn't have to take these actions all in the same turn, but if they take any other actions in between, the target has to start over. The items eject into the target's space, possibly spilling out into adjacent spaces if there's too much to fit.

When the spell ends or the target falls unconscious, the contents of the extradimensional storage are disgorged in a riotous spew, landing in the nearest unoccupied space, a bit wet but otherwise unharmed.

**Heightened (5th)** The duration increases to 8 hours.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Bracing Tendrils
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: Visible tendrils of force anchor your body to the ground, preventing unwanted movement.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
Visible tendrils of force anchor your body to the ground, preventing unwanted movement. Whenever you're on the ground and a creature or effect attempts to forcibly move you from your space, you can use your spell DC in place of your Fortitude DC as the DC of the check to move you. If a creature wouldn't normally need a check to move you, it must succeed at an appropriate check (usually an Athletics check for physical movement) against your spell DC or you are unmoved; if an effect wouldn't normally need a check to move you, it must counteract *bracing tendrils* or you are unmoved. When a creature fails to move you in this way, you can choose to have the tendrils lash back and push them 5 feet away from you.

While the tendrils anchor you in place when you come to a stop, they uproot easily to cooperate with your own voluntary movement, so you can still move freely while under the effect of the spell.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Burglar's Blind
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: The only thing thieves love more than being silent and stealthy is the piles of gold they win with that silence and stealth.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
The only thing thieves love more than being silent and stealthy is the piles of gold they win with that silence and stealth. You mask the target with multiple illusions combined in a perfect mix, affecting them with both the Invisibility and Silence spells. If the target takes a hostile action, *burglar's blind* and both the spells it grants end after the hostile action is completed.

**Heightened (5th)** You can target up to 5 willing creatures. The spells end for all targets if any one of them takes a hostile action.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Burning Trail
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: The target's feet glow with a magical flame that lingers and grows on the ground where they walk, creating a line of blazing fire as they move.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
The target's feet glow with a magical flame that lingers and grows on the ground where they walk, creating a line of blazing fire as they move. The first time the target Strides during the spell's duration, they leave behind a trail made of magical fire that fills up each space they occupied during that Stride. This fire is 5 feet high. Creatures on either side of the trail are concealed from creatures on the opposite side. Any creature that enters or starts its turn in the trail's area takes 2d10 fire damage.

**Heightened (+2)** The fire damage increases by 1d10.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Chosen Gravity
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: The target can change the direction gravity pulls them after they touch a surface with their feet.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
The target can change the direction gravity pulls them after they touch a surface with their feet. The target can walk on vertical surfaces or upside down as though gravity was pulling them toward the surface. In addition, the target gains a +1 status bonus to their saving throws and Fortitude DC against forced movement. When the spell ends, the target is affected by gravity as normal and might fall if not on the floor.

**Heightened (6th)** The duration increases to 1 hour.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Claim Curse
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: By burning threads of fate around a target and then retying them to yourself instead, you temporarily draw their curse to you, offering them brief succor from the worst of its effects.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description: By burning threads of fate around a target and then retying them to yourself instead, you temporarily draw their curse to you, offering them brief succor from the worst of its effects. Choose a curse affecting the target that you don't already have. For 5 minutes, you're affected by the curse (at the same stage as the target, and it can't be changed, if applicable), and the target isn't. If the curse's duration ends before claim curse would, it ends as normal; otherwise, when the spell's duration ends the curse's effects return to the target as normal.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Companion's Shadow
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: The shadow of your companion joins in the fight.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description: The shadow of your companion joins in the fight. The first time your companion Strikes each round, their shadow can also make an unarmed Strike against a different creature within range using the same multiple attack penalty as the original attack. The shadow's Strike deals void damage instead of any other damage type the Strike would normally do. Both attacks contribute to your companion's multiple attack penalty as normal.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Corpse Bloom
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You conjure three deadly clusters of flesh-devouring fungi.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
**Area** three 5-foot bursts that don't overlap

You conjure three deadly clusters of flesh-devouring fungi. Whenever a creature starts its turn in one of the clusters or the first time a creature enters a cluster each round, it takes 3d4 poison damage with a Fortitude save as poisonous spores fill the air. Corpses within a cluster rapidly decompose.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes half damage and becomes Sickened 1.

**Failure** The target takes full damage and becomes sickened 1.

**Critical Failure** The target takes double damage and becomes Sickened 2.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d4.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Croak Voice
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You cause the target creature's vocal chords to swell like those of a frog.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You cause the target creature's vocal chords to swell like those of a frog. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target's voice becomes hoarse, and speaking becomes painful. Whenever it uses an action that has the auditory trait or attempts to Cast a Spell that doesn't have the subtle trait, it must succeed at a DC 5 flat or the action is lost. Once per round, the target can spend an Interact action to massage its throat, attempting a Fortitude save against your spell DC. On a success, the spell ends.

**Failure** As success, but using an action with the auditory trait also deals 2d10 mental damage to the target as the sound of its distorted voice grates on its ears.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the damage for using an action with the auditory trait is doubled, and the target can't use an Interact action to attempt a Fortitude save to end the effect early.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage for using an action with the auditory trait increases by 1d10.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.cite: Howl of the Wild — Spells: Croak Voice

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Day's Weight
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You fast-forward time for a single creature, burdening it with the aches and pain of an entire day and temporarily making it tired and weak.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You fast-forward time for a single creature, burdening it with the aches and pain of an entire day and temporarily making it tired and weak. The creature must attempt a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is fatigued and Enfeebled 1 for 1 round.

**Failure** The target is fatigued and enfeebled 1 for the duration.

**Critical Failure** The target is fatigued and Enfeebled 2 for the duration. The fatigued condition doesn't end when the spell's duration does (but can still be removed with a night's rest or by similar means).

**Heightened (6th)** You can target up to 10 creatures.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Defensive Prescience
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: Your eyes widen as you watch the attack, slowing it down in your mind as you look at the possibilities that lie ahead.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
**Trigger** A creature targets your familiar with an attack.

Your eyes widen as you watch the attack, slowing it down in your mind as you look at the possibilities that lie ahead. Reaching out, you twist the strands of fate, creating a glitch in this instance to protect your vulnerable familiar. The target must attempt a Will save.

**Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Failure** The creature must roll twice and use the worse result on its attack roll; if its attack is a critical failure, the target takes 3d10 force damage.

**Critical Failure** The creature must roll twice and use the worse result on its attack roll; if its attack is a failure, the target takes 3d10 force damage.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d10.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Dividing Trench
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You dig an earthen trench across the surrounding terrain, which must be soil, clay, sand, or other soft earth, but not flooring or stone.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You dig an earthen trench across the surrounding terrain, which must be soil, clay, sand, or other soft earth, but not flooring or stone. The trench is 5 feet wide, 5 feet deep, and up to 15 feet long. You can shape the trench's path, but it must be one continuous line. You must conjure the trench in an open space so it doesn't pass through any creatures or objects. Creatures inside the trench have cover from creatures outside the trench, and creatures outside the trench have cover from creatures inside the trench. Small or smaller creatures in the trench might have greater cover against other creatures who aren't close to the trench's edge, and in turn, those creatures might have more cover against small creatures in the trench; the GM determines the amount of additional cover, if any. Entering or leaving the trench requires an additional 5 feet of movement but doesn't require any kind of check and isn't considered difficult terrain. At the end of the spell's duration, the trench disappears, and all creatures in the trench remain in their spaces on solid ground.

**Heightened (+2)** The trench's maximum length increases by 15 feet.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Elemental Absorption
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You absorb elemental energy, which you can release as a powerful counterattack.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You absorb elemental energy, which you can release as a powerful counterattack. Choose air, earth, fire, metal, water, or wood. You gain resistance 5 to damage dealt by effects with the chosen elemental trait; if you choose water, you also gain resistance 5 to cold damage. As usual, if a spell has multiple effects, such as a spell that deals both fire damage and bludgeoning damage with superheated rocks, you gain resistance to only the effects associated with the element you chose. Keep track of how much damage you've prevented with this spell.

As a 2-action activity, which has the concentrate trait and the trait matching the element you chose, you can release the stored energy. This deals damage equal to the amount you've prevented (maximum 30) to one enemy within 60 feet, with a basic Reflex save. The damage type depends on the element you chose: bludgeoning or slashing damage for air; bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage for earth; fire damage for fire; electricity or slashing damage for metal; bludgeoning or cold damage for water; or bludgeoning or vitality damage for wood. After releasing the energy, the spell ends. If you don't use the stored energy before the spell ends, the energy is lost

Spell Effect: Elemental Absorption

**Heightened (+3)** The resistance increases by 5, and the maximum damage increases by 30.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Envenom Companion
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You envenom your companion or eidolon's attacks, which drip with highly toxic venom for the spell's duration.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You envenom your companion or eidolon's attacks, which drip with highly toxic venom for the spell's duration. The first time each round the target hits a creature with an unarmed Strike that deals piercing or slashing damage, that Strike deals an additional 1d8 poison damage. A creature that is damaged by this poison must attempt a Fortitude save. On a failure, it's also Clumsy 1 for 1 round. This spell can't target familiars.

Spell Effect: Envenom Companion

**Heightened (+3)** The poison damage increases by 1d8 and the clumsy value imposed on a failed save increases by 1.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Familiar's Call
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: Your familiar dissolves and rematerializes in your space.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
Your familiar dissolves and rematerializes in your space. The exact appearance of this teleportation differs based on your tradition (a druid's familiar might fall into a spray of autumn leaves, a shadowy familiar might simply fade away), but it's always clearly supernatural.

**Heightened (5th)** You can call your familiar so long as your familiar is on the same planet as you.

**Heightened (7th)** You can call your familiar so long as your familiar is on the same plane of existence as you.

**Heightened (9th)** You can call your familiar even if the familiar is on a different plane of existence.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Far Reach
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You conjure two tiny portals in midair: one in your own space and another in any unoccupied space within range that you can see.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description: You conjure two tiny portals in midair: one in your own space and another in any unoccupied space within range that you can see. As long as you occupy the space of a portal, you can see, hear, and reach through the portal in your space to Interact with creatures, objects, or the environment as if you were in the space of the other portal. Only you can use and benefit from these portals, although friendly creatures might be able to hand you items or otherwise Interact with whatever extremities you extend through them. No creature, including you, can pass entirely through either portal, even one occupying an extradimensional container.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Focusing Hum
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You infuse the air around you with a sustained hum that allows creatures within it to resist distractions.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description: You infuse the air around you with a sustained hum that allows creatures within it to resist distractions. The DC of any flat check to Cast a Spell while stupefied for creatures within the area is 2 lower. confused creatures in the area don't attack anyone, including themselves, and instead lose the ability to speak coherently. You take a -2 penalty to Stealth checks to Hide and Sneak.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Fractious Echo
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.duration: until the end of your next turn
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: A single powerful blow batters the body but leaves the spirit behind and vulnerable to attack.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description: A single powerful blow batters the body but leaves the spirit behind and vulnerable to attack. Make a melee Strike that deals bludgeoning damage. If the Strike hits, the target is pushed 10 feet away from you (20 feet on a critical success) and leaves behind a spiritual echo of itself in its original space that lasts for 1 round. The echo is a creature that can take no actions. Anything that targets or would affect the target's echo affects the target and uses the target's statistics. Something that would affect both the target and the echo affects them only once. For example, a fireball spell that included both the target and its echo in the area would require the target attempt only one saving throw and damage the target only once.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Garden of Stone
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: The ground shakes as you conjure a 10-foot-tall stalagmite from below.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
The ground shakes as you conjure a 10-foot-tall stalagmite from below. The stalagmite fills the area and has AC 10, Hardness 5, and 30 Hit Points. When you Cast the Spell, all creatures in the area take 3d10 piercing damage, with a basic Reflex save, and are pushed to the nearest unoccupied space as the stalagmite rises. The area in a 20-foot emanation around the stalagmite becomes difficult terrain, as smaller stalagmites grow around it.

If the stalagmite survives to the end of the spell's duration, it remains as an ordinary, non-magical stalagmite. However, if the stalagmite is outside of a protected environment, such as a cave, it'll likely crumble away due to natural weathering over the course of a year.

**Heightened (+1)** The stalagmite has an additional 10 Hit Points, and the damage increases by 1d10.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Garden of Stone

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Ghost Rush
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You become temporarily ghostlike as you push forward, moving through obstacles in your path.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You become temporarily ghostlike as you push forward, moving through obstacles in your path. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speeds, then Stride twice. While you don't become completely incorporeal, this movement ignores the effects of difficult terrain, greater difficult terrain, and hazardous terrain and isn't impeded by physical barriers that don't block your line of sight. If the movement would end in a space that would normally be obstructed, it instead ends at the nearest unobstructed space you pass through before reaching it. You can use *ghost rush* to Fly or Swim instead of Stride if you have the corresponding movement type. If you're riding a mount or piloting a vehicle that's Large or smaller and unencumbered, you can cause the spell to affect the mount or vehicle instead, including any cargo or passengers.

Spell Effect: Ghost Rush

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Gleaming Pet
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: The target glows intensely with an otherworldly light, blinding any who approach.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
The target glows intensely with an otherworldly light, blinding any who approach. Any creature that begins its turn adjacent to the target must attempt a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected and is immune for 10 minutes.

**Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Failure** The creature is dazzled for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The creature is blinded for 1 round.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Gravity Wave
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You send forth a ripple of gravitic force, lifting enemies into the air before slamming them down to the ground, dealing 6d4 bludgeoning damage with a Fortitude save.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You send forth a ripple of gravitic force, lifting enemies into the air before slamming them down to the ground, dealing 6d4 bludgeoning damage with a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes half damage.

**Failure** The target takes full damage and falls prone.

**Critical Failure** The target takes double damage and falls prone.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d4.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Inertia Lock
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.targets: 1 held object of 2 Bulk or less
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You manipulate the fundamental forces of gravity to lock an item in place.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You manipulate the fundamental forces of gravity to lock an item in place. The object remains in the exact spot where you released it, even floating in the air, until the spell ends or the item is broken. A creature can Interact with the object to move it up to 10 feet by succeeding at an Athletics check equal to your spell DC (up to 20 feet on a critical success). After the item is moved, the spell's effects resume. You can Dismiss this spell.

**Heightened (5th)** The duration increases to 8 hours.

**Heightened (7th)** The duration is unlimited.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Invent Code
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.targets: yourself and up to 3 other willing creatures
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You grant the targets the ability to understand a newly invented language.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description: You grant the targets the ability to understand a newly invented language. While those under the spell’s effects can comprehend each other’s speech, it sounds indecipherable to others. The targets can also read and write in their new language, but they cease to understand the language once the spell’s duration has ended. If the same caster targets the same group with another use of invent code, they can once again understand their previous codes while the spell is active. Translate doesn’t allow a caster to understand the language, but it does reveal that the language is magically coded. Dispel magic and other similar effects can revert written text to a random but translatable jumble of all the languages the caster of invent code knows.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Iron Rain
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You call forth blades from the Plane of Metal, creating piercing daggers that shoot down from the sky.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You call forth blades from the Plane of Metal, creating piercing daggers that shoot down from the sky. These blades deal 6d4 piercing damage and 3 persistent bleed damage to all creatures in the area. As the rain dissipates, the ground is littered with hundreds of knives, creating difficult terrain that lasts for the duration of the spell. Any creature that's within the difficult terrain can Interact to pick up one of the knives and wield it as a mundane dagger.

**Heightened (+1)** The piercing damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Life Connection
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: When you cast this spell, you place a failsafe deep within the life force of the target that could save them in a time of need.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
When you cast this spell, you place a failsafe deep within the life force of the target that could save them in a time of need. You can sense when the target takes damage, provided you're within 1 mile of one another. A creature can be part of no more than one *life connection* simultaneously. When the spell is cast, you gain the Defend Life reaction; once you use the reaction, the spell ends.

Spell Effect: Life Connection

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Lightning Lasso
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You conjure a crackling lasso of pure electricity, hurling it at a creature to bind them in place.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You conjure a crackling lasso of pure electricity, hurling it at a creature to bind them in place. The target must attempt a Reflex save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected

**Success** The target takes 2d12 electricity damage.

**Failure** The target takes 2d12 electricity damage and is immobilized until the end of your next turn, but it can Escape. On subsequent turns, if the target is still immobilized by the lasso, you can Sustain the spell to deal level-based electricity damage and keep the target immobilized until the end of your next turn.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target is also restrained.

**Heightened (+1)** The initial electricity damage increases by 1d12, and the electricity damage dealt when you Sustain the spell increases by 2.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Lively Flight
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: Healing energy spirals toward your target, taking shape around them like majestic wings of vital energy.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
Healing energy spirals toward your target, taking shape around them like majestic wings of vital energy. The target regains 6d8 Hit Points and can Fly up to 30 feet as a free action along a path of their choice; this movement doesn't trigger reactions but can never put the target in danger, so if they attempt to move toward an enemy or into a hazard, the movement immediately ends.

**Heightened (+1)** The healing increases by 2d8.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Mind of Menace
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.traits: concentrate, contingency, emotion, fear, manipulate, mental
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: This spell wards against those who attempt to subvert your mind and turns mental magic back on them.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
This spell wards against those who attempt to subvert your mind and turns mental magic back on them. When the spell is complete, you gain the Fight with Fear reaction; once you use the reaction, the spell ends.

Spell Effect: Mind of Menace
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Mind of Menace

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Moth's Supper
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You sigh, and your breath transforms into delicate, black-winged butterflies and huge death's-head hawkmoths.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You sigh, and your breath transforms into delicate, black-winged butterflies and huge death's-head hawkmoths. They flutter about you briefly, and then range forth in search of sustenance—fresh-spilled blood, by preference, but rotting corpses, flowering plants, or even left-behind food will do in a pinch. They then return, perching on your hair or shoulders and whispering their secrets into your ears. This has three effects.

- You heal 2d4 Hit Points every 10 minutes.
- The first time during the duration when someone successfully Treats your Wounds, you regain an additional 4d4 Hit Points.
- You gain an imprecise sense out to 30 feet that senses only freshly spilled blood and rotten flesh.

**Heightened (+1)** The amount of Hit Points healed every 10 minutes increases by 1d4 and the amount of Hit Points regained from the first Treat Wounds increases by 2d4.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Overload Connection
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: Typically, the connection between a familiar and its master carries subtle mental magic only felt between the two.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
Typically, the connection between a familiar and its master carries subtle mental magic only felt between the two. Some casters learn to empower this magic, blasting scrambled lines of their mental conversations to any target between them. When you Cast this Spell and the first time you Sustain this spell on subsequent turns, this magical connection flares in a line between you and your familiar, dealing 3d8 mental damage to all creatures in the line, with a basic Reflex save.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d8.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Perceive the Threads of Fate
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You open your mind to the grand design of existence, enabling you to view the threads of fate in all their complex, tangled glory.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You open your mind to the grand design of existence, enabling you to view the threads of fate in all their complex, tangled glory. You attempt Perception checks and Reflex saving throws at mythic proficiency for the duration.

You can Sustain the spell once per round to untangle these threads. When you do, if your next action requires you to attempt an attack roll or skill check, you roll this check twice and use the higher result. You can untangle the threads of fate up to three times. After the third time, the spell ends.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.cite: War of Immortals — Spells: Perceive the Threads of Fate

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Phantom Prison
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.traits: concentrate, illusion, incapacitation, manipulate, mental, visual
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You completely surround a Large or smaller creature in immobile illusory walls, trapping it inside a false prison it can't escape.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You completely surround a Large or smaller creature in immobile illusory walls, trapping it inside a false prison it can't escape. No other creatures see or feel these walls, and the target can't see anything outside of the illusory walls. The target can attempt a Will save when the spell is cast, each time it attempts to interact with or escape the walls, and each time something from outside the walls affects the target. On a success, it disbelieves the illusion, and the spell ends.

**Heightened (8th)** You can target up to 5 creatures.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Primal Chorus
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You let loose a primal howl that incites animals and beasts to join in the chorus.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You let loose a primal howl that incites animals and beasts to join in the chorus. Doing so gives you a general idea of how many creatures with the animal or beast trait are within the range of the spell, but significant creatures can attempt a Will save against your spell DC to resist responding to your call. You gain a +1 status bonus to your next Initiative roll in an encounter with an enemy creature that replies to your call. For purposes of using Coerce during exploration mode, you can communicate with a creature that responds to your call for the duration of the spell. You can only make simple commands, such as approach or hide, and only understand simple ideas, such as compliance with the order or the presence of natural hazards.

**Heightened (+2)** The status bonus increases by 1.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.cite: Howl of the Wild — Spells: Primal Chorus

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Rally Point
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You mark the area touched as a rally point.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You mark the area touched as a rally point. During the spell's duration, you can take a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to teleport to the rally point along with items you are wearing or holding. This teleportation fails if the area is occupied, if the rally point is more than 120 feet away, or if you try to bring along any other creature, even if it's in an extradimensional container. Once you teleport to the rally point, the spell's duration ends.

**Heightened (7th)** You can designate up to four other creatures within 30 feet, in addition to yourself. Each of these creatures can teleport to the rally point once during the spell's duration by taking a single action, which has the concentrate trait. The spell's duration no longer ends once you teleport to the rally point, though you still can't teleport to the rally point again.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Reblooded
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: Your enemy's heart has been stopped, but you cause it to start pumping blood once again.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
Your enemy's heart has been stopped, but you cause it to start pumping blood once again. The unfamiliar sensation is enough to throw the creature off-kilter, while the blood itself damages the flesh of the undead. The target attempts a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes 1d6 persistent acid damage.

**Failure** The creature is Clumsy 1 for 1 minute and takes 2d6 persistent acid damage.

**Critical Failure** The creature is Clumsy 2 for 1 minute and takes 3d6 persistent acid damage.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Rend Magic
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You spew forth pure magical energy down your arm before releasing it in a devastating attack.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You spew forth pure magical energy down your arm before releasing it in a devastating attack. Make a melee spell attack against the target's AC. If it hits, the target takes 3d10 force damage, then takes level-based force damage each time it Casts a Spell for 1 minute; on a critical hit, double the initial damage and the damage when the target casts spells. This spell ends immediately if the target ends its turn without Casting a Spell.

**Heightened (+2)** The initial force damage increases by 2d10, and the force damage taken whenever the target casts a spell increases by 1d10.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Restraining Chains
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.targets: 1 creature touching or standing on a solid surface
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: A steel chain materializes from the surface, fettered to one space of your choice that the target occupies, weaving itself around the creature's limbs.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
A steel chain materializes from the surface, fettered to one space of your choice that the target occupies, weaving itself around the creature's limbs. The chain continuously pulls on the target and impedes its movement. The chain has AC 10, Hardness 5, and 30 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target can only move up to 20 feet away from where the chains are fettered until the chains are broken or the target Escapes.

**Failure** The target is Clumsy 1 and can only move up to 10 feet away from where the chains are fettered until the chains are broken or the target Escapes.

**Critical Failure** The chain binds the target tighter. The target is Clumsy 2 and can only move up to 5 feet away from where the chains are fettered until the chains are broken or the target Escapes.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Roaring Applause
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: Your flamboyant flourish invokes such powerful feelings in your audience that you incite cheers and applause.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
Your flamboyant flourish invokes such powerful feelings in your audience that you incite cheers and applause. The target of this spell must be able to see, hear, or otherwise understand you. The target must attempt a Will save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target becomes mildly distracted and applauds while it isn't fully occupied. It can't use reactions.

**Failure** The target applauds you so vigorously that it can't use reactions and is Slowed 1. The applause is so involved that it has the manipulate trait. This triggers reactions based on the manipulate trait at the start of the target's turn.

**Critical Failure** As failure, plus the target is so distracted by its vigorous applauding of you that it's fascinated with you.

**Heightened (6th)** You can target up to 10 creatures.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Sea of Thought
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You cover the area in a sloshing torrent of semi-solidified thought, roughly ankle high.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You cover the area in a sloshing torrent of semi-solidified thought, roughly ankle high. The area becomes difficult terrain, similarly to a shallow bog. Each round that a creature starts its turn in the area, it must attempt a Fortitude save against the shifting waves of thought. On a failure, it takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until it leaves the area, and on a critical failure, it is also knocked prone.

**Heightened (+1)** The radius of the spell's area increases by 5 feet.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Spells: Sea of Thought

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Shadow Projectile
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You create an illusory duplicate of your ally's ranged attack.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
**Trigger** An ally within 20 feet of you makes a ranged attack roll.

You create an illusory duplicate of your ally's ranged attack. You launch an illusory double of your ally's projectile or spell at the same target, leaving the enemy unsure which attack to avoid. The target takes 3d8 mental damage, depending on its Will save. Regardless of the result of its save, it's temporarily immune to *shadow projectile* for 1 hour.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is off-guard against the triggering attack.

**Failure** The creature is off-guard against the triggering attack and takes full damage from your illusory projectile.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but double damage.

**Heightened (+2)** The damage increases by 1d8.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Shadow Spy
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.duration: until the next time you make your daily preparations
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You mix blood, soil, and shadow together to form a half-real homunculus in the shape of a crow, sparrow, or other bird.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description: You mix blood, soil, and shadow together to form a half-real homunculus in the shape of a crow, sparrow, or other bird. You then command the bird to fly to a location within range and observe all around it. The bird has the statistics of a Homunculus, save that it has all of your senses and shares your Perception modifier. Once the spell's duration elapses or upon a trigger you set (which must be fairly simple—"at dusk" or "when the judge leaves"), the bird flies to your location. If you wring its neck and drink its blood, you learn all that it saw since its creation.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Skyglass Prison
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: The air around the target solidifies like glass, trapping the creature in a cage that perfectly encases them, making movement nearly impossible.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
The air around the target solidifies like glass, trapping the creature in a cage that perfectly encases them, making movement nearly impossible. A creature targeted with this spell must attempt a Fortitude save. The cage has AC 10, Hardness 5, and 30 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. When a creature Escapes or the cage is destroyed, shards of hardened air cut the target creature, dealing 3d4 slashing damage. You can Dismiss this spell to destroy the cage.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is immobilized until it Escapes or until the cage is destroyed. The cage is automatically destroyed at the start of your next turn.

**Failure** The target is immobilized until it Escapes or until the cage is destroyed.

**Critical Failure** The target is restrained until it Escapes or until the cage is destroyed.

**Heightened (+1)** The cage's Hit Points increase by 10, and the slashing damage increases by 1d4.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Soothing Blossoms
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: Blossoms grow from the ground in a small area, soothing away afflictions and persistent pains and harm.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
Blossoms grow from the ground in a small area, soothing away afflictions and persistent pains and harm. When any creature in that area rolls a successful save against a poison or disease effect, it gets a critical success instead. The blossoms grant assisted recovery to everyone in the area to end their persistent damage, both when the spell is cast and at the start of each of your turns.

Once the duration ends, the flowers lose their magical effect, but a few of them might survive in the area as long as they can naturally. This spell doesn't give a benefit on a save against an affliction unless the stage lasts 10 minutes or less.

Spell Effect: Soothing Blossoms

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Soul Cutter
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You conjure a blade of spiritual energy and cut at the soul of a foe.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You conjure a blade of spiritual energy and cut at the soul of a foe. Make a melee spell attack against your target's AC. On a success, you deal spirit damage. On a critical success, the target takes double damage. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines the range, damage, and other parameters.

◆ An adjacent target takes 3d6 spirit damage.

◆◆ An adjacent target takes 6d6 spirit damage, and on a hit, it becomes Enfeebled 1 for 1 round.

◆◆◆ The blade flies out from you and attacks a target within 30 feet, dealing 6d6 spirit damage. The spell deals half damage on a failure (but not a critical failure), as the blade's divine influence guides your attack. Unless you critically fail, the target becomes enfeebled 1 for 1 round.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d6 for the 1-action version, or by 2d6 for the 2- and 3-action versions.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Speak With Magic
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with spells and magic items of the same tradition used to Cast this Spell, or that have the magical trait and no tradition…
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with spells and magic items of the same tradition used to Cast this Spell, or that have the magical trait and no tradition trait. When you do, your voice drops into a strange, ethereal register, and you speak a language that resembles a more fundamental version of Draconic. Speak with magic doesn't make them more friendly than normal. Though magic isn't intelligent, you speak with the essence of the spell or magic item, which has a personality colored by the type of effect and its purpose as well as by the caster of the spell or creator of the item. A spell or magic item's perspective, perception, and knowledge give it a worldview different enough from a human's that it doesn't consider the same details important. They can mostly answer questions about their creator or caster, creatures that possessed or interacted with them in the past, and what the purpose of their magic is.

**Heightened (4th)** You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with spells and magic items of any tradition.

**Heightened (6th)** As 4th rank, and the duration is 8 hours.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Speak With Magic

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Spectral Blade
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You conjure a spectral throwing blade that always returns to your hand.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You conjure a spectral throwing blade that always returns to your hand. You throw the blade when you Cast this Spell and the first time you Sustain this spell on subsequent turns, making a ranged spell attack against the AC of a creature within 20 feet. On a hit, you deal 3d6 spirit damage (or double damage on a critical hit). These attacks ignore any circumstance bonuses the target has to AC.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d6.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Spontaneous Cartography
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: Memory alone isn't always sufficient for charting an area.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
Memory alone isn't always sufficient for charting an area. You concentrate on a blank piece of parchment in your possession and record the landscape and geographical features within range. The resulting map bears crude but recognizable symbols to represent structures, landmarks, and pathways but doesn't label them.

**Heightened (6th)** The range of this spell increases to 10 miles, and major landmarks are labeled. A small star shows the spot where you are when the map is created.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Temporal Twin
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.duration: until the end of your next turn
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You pull a fleeting duplicate of your ally from the recent past.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You pull a fleeting duplicate of your ally from the recent past. The duplicate appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within 30 feet of you and repeats a basic single action the target took since the end of your last turn, such as making a Strike or Interacting to pull a lever. Because the other basic single actions don't produce much of a result on their own, this is typically used for Strike and Interact, though occasionally it could be useful to have a *temporal twin* Stride through a potentially dangerous area to expose a hazard. Immediately after you cast this spell, the target ally spends a reaction to create the duplicate, makes any decisions, and rolls for the repeated action, such as choosing a target for a Strike and making the attack roll. If the ally doesn't have a reaction to spend, *temporal twin* fails. Use the duplicate's location for determining flanking, cover, and the like. Using this spell requires remembering what your ally did, and if you don't remember the details, the GM might not allow you to cast *temporal twin*.

This action can't be used for anything but a basic single action, nor can it use limited resources. The action can have a different target than the original action but must be very similar in form. For example, if the original action were to Interact to pull a lever, the time duplicate could pull a different lever but couldn't turn a doorknob or pick up an item from a table. Being pulled through time to create a twin destabilizes the target's timeline. Once an ally has been the target of *temporal twin*, they're temporarily immune for 1 day.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Time Jump
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You leap through time, appearing across the battlefield in the blink of an eye.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You leap through time, appearing across the battlefield in the blink of an eye. You gain 2 actions, each of which must be used to Leap, Stand, Step, or Stride. If you have an appropriate Speed, you can add Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim to this list.

While you take these actions, time pauses. All other creatures are completely unaware of your actions, can't speak, and can't use any actions that would be triggered by your movement. While you're taking these actions, you can't take any other actions, including any that would be triggered by the move actions. Once the actions are complete, time starts again, and to onlookers, you seem to have suddenly teleported across the distance you traveled. Leaping forward through time is disorienting, so if you use *time jump* again within 1 minute of using the spell, you become Stupefied 4 for 1 minute.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Time Pocket
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.targets: one item of 1 Bulk or less that a willing creature is holding
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You fling the target item forward in time and link it to the future of the creature holding it.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You fling the target item forward in time and link it to the future of the creature holding it. The item disappears. When the spell ends, the item reappears with the creature that was holding it when you Cast the Spell. If the creature has enough hands free to hold the item, it appears in their hands. Otherwise, it falls to the ground in the creature's space.

You can Dismiss the spell, and it automatically ends if you're reduced to 0 Hit Points or cast time pocket again.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Tiny Wings
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You hold your familiar in your arms and then throw them into the sky—whereupon they sprout wings and take flight.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You hold your familiar in your arms and then throw them into the sky—whereupon they sprout wings and take flight. The wings look appropriate to the familiar's nature. A tabby cat might simply grow a pair of grayish wings like a pigeon, while a frog grows membranous wings a bit like a bat. Your familiar gains a 20-foot fly Speed.

Familiars who already have a fly Speed instead gain a +15-foot status bonus to their fly Speed.

Spell Effect: Tiny Wings

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Tracking Mayflies
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You shape a magical swarm of ephemeral mayflies, which direct your shot as it soars through the sky.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description: You shape a magical swarm of ephemeral mayflies, which direct your shot as it soars through the sky. Make a ranged Strike. For this Strike, double your weapon's range increment. If the target is under the effect of a spell, is wielding a magic item, or is wearing a magic item, it's off-guard against this Strike, as the mayflies become increasingly unpredictable when hunting a source of magic. If the target was invisible, the target becomes concealed to this Strike instead. If the target was already concealed for any other reason, it's no longer concealed to this Strike. If the Strike is successful, the target is dazzled for 1 round as the mayflies swarm around the target's face.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Travel by Turtle
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You conjure an intelligent sea turtle, who agrees to carry you upon its shell on a water journey.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You conjure an intelligent sea turtle, who agrees to carry you upon its shell on a water journey. This turtle must be conjured into a large body of water within range, such as a lake or broad river. The turtle conjured is Large, is capable of carrying one Medium creature or up to four Small creatures, and has a swim Speed of 30 feet. The turtle doesn't engage in combat and doesn't put itself intentionally into harm's way, but it does convey you to a destination of your choice and follows your suggestions. The turtle otherwise functions as a boat, save that it controls itself and doesn't need to be piloted.

**Heightened (5th)** The turtle's size increases to Huge, making it capable of carrying one Large creature, up to four Medium creatures, or up to 16 Small creatures. Its swim Speed increases to 40 feet, and the duration increases to 1 day.

**Heightened (7th)** The turtle's size increases to Gargantuan, making it capable of carrying one Huge creature, up to four Large creatures, up to 16 Medium creatures, or up to 32 Small creatures. Its swim Speed increases to 50 feet, and the duration increases to 1 week.

**Heightened (9th)** The turtle's size increases to Gargantuan, making it capable of carrying two Huge creatures, up to eight Large creatures, up to 32 Medium creatures, or up to 64 Small creatures. Its swim Speed increases to 60 feet, and the duration increases to 1 month.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.cite: War of Immortals — Spells: Travel by Turtle

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Warding Aggression
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You channel a magical ward through your attack and attempt to plant it on a foe.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You channel a magical ward through your attack and attempt to plant it on a foe. This ward increases your defenses against that foe, as long as you keep attacking that foe to maintain it. Make a melee Strike with a weapon or unarmed attack against a foe. In addition to the normal effects of the Strike, it has the effects below. *Warding aggression* ends if the foe you attacked dies or at the end of any turn in which you didn't hit that foe with a melee Strike.

**Critical Success** You gain a +3 status bonus to AC against the foe for 1 round and a +2 status bonus to AC against the foe for the remaining duration.

**Success** You gain a +2 status bonus to AC against the foe.

**Failure** You gain a +1 status bonus to AC against the foe.

**Critical Failure** You gain no additional effect.

Spell Effect: Warding Aggression

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Weapon Tide
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You conjure a wave of weapons that travel along the ground.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You conjure a wave of weapons that travel along the ground. Choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing. The wave deals 4d6 untyped damage of the chosen type to creatures in the area with a basic Reflex save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines the area and other parameters.

◆◆ The spell is a 30-foot cone.

◆◆◆The spell is a 30-foot cone, and the area becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute.

**Two Rounds** If you spend 3 actions casting the spell, you can avoid finishing the spell and spend another 2 actions on your next turn to empower the spell even further. You can take other actions before finishing this spell, but the spell is lost if you Cast another Spell in between. The spell is a 60-foot cone that deals 6d6 untyped damage. The area also becomes difficult terrain and hazardous terrain for 1 minute as weapons continue to sporadically shoot from the ground. Any creature that moves into or ends its turn in one of these squares takes 2d6 untyped damage (of the same damage type chosen when you Cast the Spell). A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

**Heightened (+2)** The initial damage increases by 4d6, and the damage of the hazardous terrain increases by 1d6.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Web of Eyes
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You place an invisible scrying sensor on each target just above their eyes.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You place an invisible scrying sensor on each target just above their eyes. Each sensor looks where that target looks, and all the targets can link their vision briefly to help notice things one target sees but the others might not. Each target can use an action, which has the concentrate trait, to share what they see with any number of other targets until the start of their next turn. Only one creature can share their vision at a time, so if another target takes this action, the effect ends for any target that was previously sharing their vision.

This improves how well the recipients can perceive anything the sharing creature is looking at. For instance, if a creature is undetected to a recipient but observed by the sharing creature, the creature becomes observed by the recipient as well. Typically, the creature is seen as a glowing outline superimposed on its position. This might allow the recipient to target a creature they couldn't otherwise; however, cover and line of effect still might prevent or impede targeting and attacks. This can only improve the recipient's vision, not reduce it; for example, if an enemy was undetected by the sharing creature and observed by a recipient, the recipient would still clearly observe the enemy. Once the vision sharing stops, the benefit ends.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Web of Eyes

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Widow’s Bite
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: You conjure up a deadly stinger on your hand and stab a foe.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
You conjure up a deadly stinger on your hand and stab a foe. Make a melee spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 1d4 piercing damage and 3d4 persistent poison damage (or double damage on a critical hit). Additionally, the target is Enfeebled 1 until it removes the persistent poison damage.

**Heightened (+2)** The initial piercing damage increases by 1d4, and the persistent poison damage increases by 2d4.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.name: Blood Chestnuts
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.summary: With a wave of your arm, you launch a handful of sharp crimson seeds that bury themselves in the target's flesh.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-3-4.description:
With a wave of your arm, you launch a handful of sharp crimson seeds that bury themselves in the target's flesh. The target takes 3d8 piercing damage with a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes half the piercing damage.

**Failure** The target takes full piercing damage and becomes afflicted with draining growth at stage 1.

**Critical Failure** The target takes double the piercing damage and becomes afflicted with draining growth at stage 2.

**Draining Growth** (disease) The target can't reduce their drained condition while afflicted by draining growth

**Stage 1** Drained 1 (1 round)

**Stage 2** Drained 2 (1 round),
