◆◆ This spell is a 30-foot cone, dealing 5d6 electricity damage and 5d6 fire damage.

◆◆◆ This spell is a 60-foot cone, dealing 5d6 electricity damage and 5d6 fire damage. Creatures that fail their saves become Sickened 1 (Sickened 2 on a critical failure) due to their exposure to cosmic radiation.

**Heightened (+2)** The damage increases by 1d6 for each damage type with the 1-action version, or by 2d6 for each damage type for the 2- and 3-action versions.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Psychic Outburst
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: Psychic energy filters through your mind and explodes outward, dealing mental damage to creatures in the area with a basic Will save.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
Psychic energy filters through your mind and explodes outward, dealing mental damage to creatures in the area with a basic Will save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines the damage and other parameters.

◆◆ The spell deals 6d10 mental damage.

◆◆◆The spell deals 6d10 mental damage. Creatures that fail their save are pushed 10 feet away from you (or 20 feet on a critical failure).

**Two Rounds** If you spend 3 actions Casting the Spell, you can avoid finishing the spell and spend another 2 actions on your next turn to empower the spell even further. You can take other actions before finishing this spell, but the spell is lost if you Cast another Spell in between. The area increases to a 40-foot emanation, deals 8d10 mental damage, and targets only enemies. Creatures that fail their save are pushed 10 feet away from you (20 feet on a critical failure).

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d10.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Quicken Time
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You speed up the time stream in an area, stretching and pulling it until time flows swift and wild.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description: You speed up the time stream in an area, stretching and pulling it until time flows swift and wild. Any creature that begins its turn in the area is quickened until the end of its turn and can use the extra action only to Stride or Strike. Unfortunately, speeding up time is much more difficult than slowing it down, and the effect is uneven and jittery, making accuracy between times painfully difficult; creatures inside the area are concealed to those outside it, and vice versa.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Rewinding Step
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You anchor your location in time so that you can swiftly retrace your steps later with complex chronomancy.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You anchor your location in time so that you can swiftly retrace your steps later with complex chronomancy. The space you're in when you Cast the Spell becomes your temporal anchor space. While you're within 500 feet of your temporal anchor space, you can Sustain this spell to instantaneously return to that space (you don't need to have line of effect). The spell then ends. You bring any items that are in your possession with you when you take the action to return.

If the anchor space is occupied when you attempt to return to it or if this spell would bring another creature with you, the spell fails to transport you, then ends.

**Heightened (7th)** You can return if you're within 1,000 feet of your anchor space.

**Heightened (9th)** You can return if you're within 1 mile of your anchor space.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Rip the Spirit
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You supernaturally rip the spirit from a living creature's body, dooming the target to pain and death.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You supernaturally rip the spirit from a living creature's body, dooming the target to pain and death. The target takes 5d6 void damage, depending on its basic Fortitude save, and is also Drained 1 if it fails its save. The spell's effect is based on how many actions you spend when Casting the Spell.

◆ The spell targets one living creature in range.

◆◆ (concentrate) The spell targets one living creature in range, and the damage is 10d6 void damage instead of 5d6.

◆◆◆ (concentrate) The spell targets all living creatures in a 30-foot emanation.

**Heightened (+1)** The amount of damage increases by 1d6, or by 2d6 for the 2-action version.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Rip the Spirit

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Shock and Awe
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.traits: auditory, concentrate, emotion, fear, illusion, manipulate, mental, visual
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You create the illusion of cannons exploding, bullets and arrows flying, and magical ballistics firing, as an overwhelming torrent of information, both visual and auditory.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You create the illusion of cannons exploding, bullets and arrows flying, and magical ballistics firing, as an overwhelming torrent of information, both visual and auditory. Enemies in the area must attempt a Will save.

**Critical Success** The enemy is unaffected.

**Success** The target is Frightened 1.

**Failure** The enemy is Frightened 2 and Stunned 1.

**Critical Failure** The enemy is Frightened 3 and Stunned 2.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Space Fold Gate
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You manipulate the fabric of space-time, temporarily bringing two distant points together, connected by a magical gate.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You manipulate the fabric of space-time, temporarily bringing two distant points together, connected by a magical gate. Choose two unoccupied 5-foot squares on solid ground that you can see within range. You create spherical portals in both squares that are 5 feet tall and 5 feet wide connecting the two locations. Any creature that enters one portal can immediately transport itself to the exit portal as a part of its move action, which adds the teleportation trait to its movement (this movement still triggers reactions as normal). Physical objects can pass through the portal normally, as though the portals were adjacent. Ranged attacks made through the portals treat them as only one 5-foot square for the purpose of calculating range. Spells cast through the portals have no effect.

**Heightened (6th)** Range increases to 500 feet, and the portals can be made up to 10 feet tall and 10 feet wide.

**Heightened (7th)** Range increases to 1,000 feet, and the portals can be made up to 30 feet tall and 30 feet wide.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Space Fold Gate

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Spiked Carapace
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: Your bones harmlessly puncture the skin of one arm, growing to form a hardened spiked gauntlet that can be used for both offense and defense.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
Your bones harmlessly puncture the skin of one arm, growing to form a hardened spiked gauntlet that can be used for both offense and defense. Make a melee spell attack against a target's AC, dealing 5d8 piercing damage and 1d8 persistent bleed damage (double damage on a critical hit). You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your AC for the duration, as you deflect attacks with the gauntlet.

Spell Effect: Spiked Carapace

**Heightened (+2)** The initial damage increases by 2d8 and persistent bleed damage increases by 1d8.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Stagnate Time
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You examine the time stream in a particular area, then proceed to stick a few metaphorical pins into it, thickening and slowing down the flow of time until it rumbles along like a river of molasses.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You examine the time stream in a particular area, then proceed to stick a few metaphorical pins into it, thickening and slowing down the flow of time until it rumbles along like a river of molasses. Any creature that begins its turn in the area must attempt a Will save.

**Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Failure** The creature is Slowed 1 this turn.

**Critical Failure** The creature is Slowed 2 this turn.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Tornadic Gale
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: A spinning gale of violent air bursts forth from you, drawing creatures into its vortex.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
A spinning gale of violent air bursts forth from you, drawing creatures into its vortex. All Medium or smaller creatures that are adjacent to the line are pulled to the nearest unoccupied space within the line. Then, all creatures within the line take 5d12 bludgeoning damage and must attempt a Reflex save.

**Critical Success** The target takes no damage.

**Success** The target takes half damage.

**Failure** The target takes full damage and is pushed 5 feet away from you.

**Critical Failure** The target takes double damage, is pushed 10 feet away from you, and is knocked prone.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d12.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Tree of Life and Death
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.traits: concentrate, healing, manipulate, plant, vitality, void, wood
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: The cycle of life includes both life and death, growth and decay.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
**Area** 2 unoccupied squares

The cycle of life includes both life and death, growth and decay. You call forth two mighty trees from the depths of the realm of the dead, one emanating with life and one with death, bound to each other as the living are to the dying. The trees must be at least 20 feet apart. Each one occupies its square, and its canopy spreads out in a 10-foot emanation. Each tree has AC 10, Hardness 10, and 50 Hit Points. They're immune to critical hits and precision damage. When either tree is reduced to 0 Hit Points or the spell ends, both trees disintegrate into a pile of dust.

- **Tree of Death** Charred branches cover the tree, and the area of its emanation fills with a foul miasma. A living creature that starts its turn within or enters the emanation takes (1d4 per level) void damage, with a basic Fortitude save. A creature can only be damaged this way once per round.
- **Tree of Life** Golden leaves cover the tree, and the area of its emanation fills with shining particles. A living creature that starts its turn within or enters the emanation regains (1d4 per level) Hit Points. A creature can only be healed this way once per round.

**Heightened (+1)** The void damage increases by 1d4, the healing increases by 1d4, and tree's Hit Points increases by 10.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Tree of Life and Death

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Unravel Existence
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You disturb a section of reality itself, tearing creatures apart at a fundamental level using your current plane of existence as fuel.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You disturb a section of reality itself, tearing creatures apart at a fundamental level using your current plane of existence as fuel. When you Cast this Spell and the first time you Sustain it on subsequent rounds, each creature in the area takes 5d10 force damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a failed save, a creature that isn't a native inhabitant of the plane also takes level-based persistent force damage and becomes off-guard until it recovers from this persistent damage. A target reduced to 0 Hit Points by either damage scatters into fine dust; its gear remains.

**Heightened (+2)** The initial and persistent force damage increases by 1d10.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Warshard Shot
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: Make a spell attack roll against the target.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
Make a spell attack roll against the target. The warshard deals 5d6 piercing damage and 5d6 spirit damage, depending on your ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC.

**Critical Success** The target takes double damage and 5 persistent spirit damage. As long as the target is taking this persistent spirit damage, it takes a –1 status penalty to its AC.

Spell Effect: Warshard Shot

**Success** The target takes full damage.

**Failure** The target takes the spirit damage, but not the piercing damage.

**Critical Failure** The target is unaffected.

**Heightened (+1)** The piercing damage and initial spirit damage each increase by 1d6. The persistent spirit damage on a critical hit increases by 1.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Weight of the World
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You force a creature to experience an instantaneous burst of severely multiplied gravity, wreaking havoc on their eyes and internal organs.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You force a creature to experience an instantaneous burst of severely multiplied gravity, wreaking havoc on their eyes and internal organs. The target takes 2d12 bludgeoning damage and 1d12 persistent bleed damage with a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes half damage, is dazzled for 1 round, and is Stunned 1.

**Failure** The target takes full damage, is dazzled for 1 minute, and is Stunned 2.

**Critical Failure** The target takes double damage, is dazzled for 1 minute, and is Stunned 3.

**Heightened (+2)** The bludgeoning damage increases by 1d12, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1d12.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Weight of the World

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Awaken Entropy
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: All things age, all things die, and at the end of days, even the universe will grow quiet and still.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
All things age, all things die, and at the end of days, even the universe will grow quiet and still. You awaken the cosmic principle of entropy, accelerating time in an area—flesh falters, plants shrivel, and even stone begins to crumble. Any creature that enters or begins its turn in the area takes 8d6 void damage with a basic Fortitude save, or 8d6 force damage if the creature normally doesn't take void damage, such as if the creature is a construct or undead. Even beings such as fiends with unlimited lifespans can be worn away by entropy.

The first time you Sustain the Spell on each subsequent turn, the entropic zone grows stronger in addition to having its duration increased. The radius of the burst increases by 10 feet (to a maximum of 40 feet), and the size of the damage dice increases by one step (from d6 to level-based void, then to level-based void, and finally to level-based void).

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d6.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Boots on the Ground
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.duration: Until you next make your daily preparations
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You craft the illusion of your army being much bigger than it actually is, hoping to overwhelm the opposing forces and shatter their hopes.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You craft the illusion of your army being much bigger than it actually is, hoping to overwhelm the opposing forces and shatter their hopes. Your illusion can create up to three illusory Gargantuan duplicates of troops within range. You can give the illusion a basic task to perform, such as standing in formation, marching, mimicking guard movements, or unloading illusory boxes; however, the illusion can't perform any actual tasks and can't create intelligible sounds, such as music or clear speech. If you and any of the illusory troops are ever farther than 500 feet apart, the spell ends.

An illusory troop's AC is equal to your spell DC. Its saving throws modifiers are equal to your spell DC – 10. If an illusory troop is hit by an attack or fails a save, you must attempt a DC 11 flat. On success, the illusion of that troop is destroyed. On failure, the entire illusion shatters, and all illusory troops are destroyed.

**Heightened (8th)** The DC of the is lowered to 8 (DC 8 flat), and you can create up to five illusory troops.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.cite: Battlecry! — Spells: Boots on the Ground

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Bounty of the Sky
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You call forth a flock of geese that drop restorative fruits and breads from the sky as they fly overhead.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You call forth a flock of geese that drop restorative fruits and breads from the sky as they fly overhead. You or an ally in the area can Interact to collect one of these gifts, and can then either consume it as part of the same action or do so with a separate Interact action later in the spell's duration. Enemies who attempt to pick up one of these gifts find that it turns to ash in their hands. Each time a character consumes one of these gifts, they can select one of the following benefits.

- The character regains 4d6 Hit Points.
- The character reduces the stage of one poison or disease they suffer from by one stage. This can't reduce the stage below 1 or cure the affliction.
- The character reduces the value of their clumsy, drained, enfeebled, or stupefied condition by 2, or reduces two of the listed conditions by 1 each.

**Heightened (+2)** The amount of Hit Points a character regains from consuming a gift increases by 2d6.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.cite: War of Immortals — Spells: Bounty of the Sky

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Cast into Time
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You release a wave of temporal energy that sends creatures violently tumbling through time, scarring their thoughts with the information flowing around them.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You release a wave of temporal energy that sends creatures violently tumbling through time, scarring their thoughts with the information flowing around them. Although the journey can feel like it lasts for minutes or even days, the targets reappear instantly. Witnessing this chaotic flow of time and being bashed against objects from the past and future deals 5d8 mental damage and 5d6 bludgeoning damage to creatures in the area, with a Fortitude save. A creature that falls into time disappears until the end of your turn. It then reappears in the same space it left; if that space is occupied, it appears in the nearest empty space, chosen by the GM. Creatures that are immune to mental effects can still be affected by this spell but take no mental damage.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature falls into time. When it returns, it takes half damage.

**Failure** The creature falls into time. When it returns, it takes full damage and is Sickened 1.

**Critical Failure** The creature falls into time. When it returns, it takes double damage and is Sickened 2.

**Heightened (+1)** The bludgeoning damage increases by 2d6.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Cast into Time

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Cryostasis
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You encase a dying creature in a protective layer of enchanted ice, halting their descent toward death.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You encase a dying creature in a protective layer of enchanted ice, halting their descent toward death. The target is completely frozen in ice and remains unconscious but stable. For the duration of the spell, they don't attempt recovery checks or take persistent damage. The creature can't act, speak, or perceive anything while in this state and doesn't need to breathe, eat food, or drink water to remain alive. You can Dismiss the spell to shatter the ice and release the target.

The ice block has AC 10, Hardness 10, and 60 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. While the ice remains unbroken, the encased creature can't take damage or be the target of spells. If the ice is destroyed, the spell ends immediately, though the creature is stabilized.

**Heightened (8th)** The duration becomes unlimited, and the ice block's Hit Points increase by 20.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Daemon Form
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You infuse yourself with the corrupting death and pure malevolence of the daemonic wastes, transforming into a Large daemon battle form.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You infuse yourself with the corrupting death and pure malevolence of the daemonic wastes, transforming into a Large daemon battle form. You must have enough space to expand into, or the spell is lost. When you Cast this Spell, you choose lacridaemon, leukodaemon, meladaemon, or venedaemon. The battle form is Medium if you choose lacridaemon or venedaemon. While in this form, you gain the daemon, fiend, and unholy traits. You have hands in this battle form and can use manipulate actions. You can Dismiss the spell.

You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of the form that you choose:

- AC = 21 + your level. Ignore your armor check's penalty and Speed reduction.
- 20 temporary Hit Points and weakness 5 to holy.
- A +2 status bonus to all saving throws against death effects.
- Resistance 10 to poison.
- Darkvision.
- One or more attacks specific to the battle form you use, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +21, and your damage bonus is +12. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.
- Athletics modifier of +23, unless your own modifier is higher.

You also gain specific abilities based on the type of Daemon you choose:

- **Lacridaemon** Speed 25 feet, fly 40 feet; resistance 10 to cold: **Size** Medium; **Melee** ◆ jaws (magical, unholy), **Damage** 1d8 piercing plus 1d6 cold and 1d4 poison; **Melee** ◆ claw (agile, magical, unholy), **Damage** 1d6 slashing plus 1d6 cold.
- **Leukodaemon** Speed 25 feet, fly 40 feet; +2 status bonus to saves against diseases: **Size** Large; **Melee** ◆ jaws (magical, reach 10 feet, unholy), **Damage** 2d10 piercing; **Melee** ◆ claw (agile, magical, reach 10 feet, unholy), **Damage** 2d6 slashing; **Ranged** ◆ composite longbow (deadly d10, magical, range increment 100 feet, unholy, volley), **Damage** 2d8 piercing.
- **Meladaemon** Speed 25 feet, fly 40 feet: **Size** Large; **Melee** ◆ jaws (magical, reach 10 feet, unholy), **Damage** 2d10 piercing; **Melee** ◆ claw (agile, magical, reach 10 feet, unholy, void), **Damage** 1d6 slashing plus 1d6 void, and after a successful Strike, you can spend an action to attempt to Grab the target.
- **Venedaemon** Speed 25 feet; sense magical items and active spells within 60 feet as an imprecise sense: **Size** Medium; **Melee** ◆ tentacle (agile, magical, reach 10 feet, unholy), **Damage** 2d6 bludgeoning.

Spell Effect: Daemon Form

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Demon Form
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You corrupt yourself with the sin of the demonic realms, transforming into a Medium demon battle form.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You corrupt yourself with the sin of the demonic realms, transforming into a Medium demon battle form. When you Cast this Spell, choose abrikandilu, brimorak, kithangian, or vloriak. If you choose kithangian, the battle form is Large, and you must have enough space to expand into, or the spell is lost. While in this form, you gain the demon, fiend, and unholy traits. You have hands in this battle form and can use manipulate actions. You can Dismiss the spell.

You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of the form that you choose:

- AC = 20 + your level. Ignore your armor check's penalty and Speed reduction.
- 30 temporary Hit Points, weakness 5 to cold iron, and weakness 5 to holy.
- Darkvision.
- One or more attacks specific to the battle form you use, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +22, and your damage bonus is +12. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example). If your attack modifier is higher for the given unarmed attack or weapon, you can use it instead.
- Athletics modifier of +23, unless your own modifier is higher.

You also gain specific abilities based on the type of demon you choose:

- **Abrikandilu** Speed 25 feet: **Melee** ◆ jaws (magical, unarmed, unholy), **Damage** 2d6 piercing, and Clumsy 1 for 1 minute on a critical hit; **Melee** ◆ claw (agile, magical, unarmed, unholy), **Damage** 2d6 slashing; **Ranged** ◆ hurled debris (range increment 20 feet, unholy), **Damage** 2d6 bludgeoning.
- **Brimorak** Speed 30 feet: **Melee** ◆ flaming sword (magical, unholy), **Damage** 2d8 slashing plus 1d6 fire; **Melee** ◆ hoof (agile, unarmed, unholy), **Damage** 2d4 bludgeoning plus 1d6 fire.
- **Kithangian** Speed 30 feet: **Melee** ◆ pincer (magical, reach 10 feet, unarmed, unholy), **Damage** 1d12 slashing, and after a successful Strike you can spend an action to attempt to Grab (Monster Core 359) the target; **Melee** ◆ stinger (agile, magical, reach 10 feet, unarmed, unholy), **Damage** 1d8 piercing; all melee Strikes deal an additional 2d6 precision damage to animals.
- **Vloriak** Speed 25 feet; resistance 10 to acid: **Melee** ◆ claw (unarmed, unholy), **Damage** 2d6 piercing plus 1d6 spirit; **Melee** ◆ tongue (agile, reach 10 feet, unarmed, unholy), **Damage** 1d6 acid plus 1d6 spirit.

Spell Effect: Demon Form

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Devil Form
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You bind yourself to the power of Hell, transforming into a Medium devil battle form.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You bind yourself to the power of Hell, transforming into a Medium devil battle form. When you Cast this Spell, choose coarti, levaloch, sarglagon, or vordine. If you choose levaloch or sarglagon, the battle form is Large, and you must have enough space to expand into, or the spell is lost. While in this form, you gain the devil, fiend, and unholy traits. You have hands in this battle form and can use manipulate actions. You can Dismiss the spell.

You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of the form that you choose:

- AC = 22 + your level. Ignore your armor check's penalty and Speed reduction.
- 5 temporary Hit Points, resistance 5 to physical damage (except silver), and weakness 5 to holy.
- Resistance 10 to fire.
- Darkvision.
- One or more attacks specific to the battle form you use, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +20, and your damage bonus is +12. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example). If your attack modifier is higher for the given unarmed attack or weapon, you can use it instead.
- Athletics modifier of +23, unless your own modifier is higher.

You also gain specific abilities based on the type of devil you choose:

- **Coarti** Speed 25 feet, fly 40 feet: **Size** Medium: **Melee** ◆ morningstar (magical, unholy, versatile P), **Damage** 2d6 bludgeoning plus 1d6 spirit; **Melee** ◆ wing (agile, unarmed, unholy, versatile P), **Damage** 1d6 bludgeoning plus 1d6 fire.
- **Levaloch** Speed 30 feet, climb 30 feet; +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude DC against being Shoved and to other saving throws to resist being moved against your will: **Size** Large: **Melee** ◆ trident (magical, unholy), **Damage** 2d8 piercing; **Ranged** ◆ trident (magical, thrown 20 feet, unholy), **Damage** 2d8 piercing; all melee Strikes deal an additional 2d6 precision damage to clumsy, enfeebled, immobilized, or restrained creatures.
- **Sarglagon** Speed 25 feet, fly 25 feet, swim 30 feet: **Size** Large: **Melee** ◆ fangs (magical, unarmed, unholy), **Damage** 2d10 piercing; **Melee** ◆ tentacle arm (agile, magical, unarmed, unholy), **Damage** 1d8 bludgeoning plus 1d6 poison.
- **Vordine** Speed 25 feet: **Size** Medium: **Melee** ◆ trident (magical, unholy), **Damage** 2d8 piercing; **Melee** ◆ hoof (agile, magical, unarmed, unholy), **Damage** 1d4 bludgeoning plus 1d6 fire; **Melee** ◆ whip (disarm, magical, nonlethal, reach 10 feet, trip, unholy), **Damage** 2d4 slashing; **Ranged** ◆ trident (magical, thrown 20 feet, unholy), **Damage** 2d8 piercing.

Spell Effect: Devil Form

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Doom Mark
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You launch a dart of dark void energy that imprints itself on the target, connecting the fates of those marked.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You launch a dart of dark void energy that imprints itself on the target, connecting the fates of those marked. Whenever you Cast this Spell and the first time you Sustain this spell on subsequent turns, make a ranged spell attack against the AC of a creature within 60 feet. On a hit, you deal 6d8 void damage (or double damage on a critical hit) and place a mark on their body for the duration of the spell. A marked creature is Enfeebled 1 and Stupefied 1. When a marked creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points, all other marked creatures become off-guard and Clumsy 1 for 1 round.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d8.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Elemental Confluence
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.traits: air, concentrate, earth, fire, manipulate, metal, water, wood
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You conjure six types of elementals who combine forces to form a chaotic storm.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You conjure six types of elementals who combine forces to form a chaotic storm. The confluence has AC 28, 120 Hit Points, weakness 10 to area effects, and immunity to bleed and poison. Creatures can move through the confluence; creatures within the confluence are concealed, and all creatures outside the confluence are concealed to creatures within it. When you Cast or Sustain this Spell, you can move the confluence up to 20 feet and choose up to two different types of elementals to act.

- **Air** (air, electricity) Bolts of electricity burst from the confluence, dealing 4d4 electricity damage to creatures within 20 feet of the confluence, with a basic Reflex save. This doesn't affect creatures that are completely inside of the confluence.
- **Earth** (earth) The confluence gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and resistance 10 to all physical damage (except adamantine) for 1 round.
- **Fire** (fire) Flames roar through the confluence, dealing 1d6 persistent fire damage to those partially or entirely inside the confluence.
- **Metal** (metal) The elemental flings shards of metal through the confluence, dealing 2d6 slashing damage to those partially or entirely inside the confluence with a basic Reflex save. A creature that critically fails also takes 1d6 persistent bleed damage.
- **Water** (attack, water) The elemental expels a powerful jet of water. Attempt a ranged spell attack against a target inside or within 60 feet of the confluence, using your spell attack modifier. This attack ignores concealment granted by the confluence, and the elemental gets a +2 circumstance bonus on the spell attack roll against a target inside the confluence. The water deals 4d6 bludgeoning damage on a hit (doubled on a critical hit). This attack doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty.
- **Wood** (wood) Roots and stumps grow, making ground in the area difficult terrain for 1 round.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Explosive Barrage
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You fire a booming, fiery explosion followed by a salvo of smaller blasts, each cracking the air with the sound of thunder.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
**Area** (continued) 20-foot burst plus additional 5-foot bursts

You fire a booming, fiery explosion followed by a salvo of smaller blasts, each cracking the air with the sound of thunder. You create a 20-foot burst and 1d4 additional 5-foot bursts each within the range and within 20 feet of another burst. None of the bursts can intersect. Each creature caught in at least one of these bursts takes 6d8 fire damage and 6d4 sonic damage (basic Fortitude save). On a failed save, a creature is also deafened for 1 minute.

**Heightened (+1)** The fire damage increases by 1d8 and the sonic damage increases by 1d4.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Expunge Blood
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You attempt to forcibly remove a massive amount of blood or other vital fluids from a creature.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You attempt to forcibly remove a massive amount of blood or other vital fluids from a creature. The target must attempt a Fortitude saving throw. A nonliving creature with blood in its body (such as a vampire) can be affected, but a creature with no blood is immune. The clumsy condition inflicted by this spell increases by 1 while the target is taking persistent bleed damage.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target becomes Drained 1 and Clumsy 1 for 1 round.

**Failure** The target becomes Drained 2 and clumsy 1 for 1 minute.

**Critical Failure** The target becomes Drained 3 and Clumsy 2 for 1 minute.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Flame Vortex
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You combine a blazing inferno and air currents into a fiery vortex.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
**Area** 5-foot radius, 40-foot tall cylinder

You combine a blazing inferno and air currents into a fiery vortex. You can Cast this Spell only if you're outside or the ceiling is 40 feet or higher. All squares in the vortex are difficult terrain for flying creatures.

All creatures in the area take 3d4 bludgeoning damage and 3d6 fire damage as gusts of fiery wind buffet them, with a basic Reflex save. Each time you Sustain the Spell, you can move the whirlwind up to 20 feet in a straight line. Each creature the whirlwind moves through takes the damage with a basic Reflex save. A creature can take damage from a flame vortex only once per round.

**Heightened (+2)** The vortex deals an additional 1d4 bludgeoning damage and 1d6 fire damage.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Frozen Fog
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You conjure a chilling mist that settles into the bones and makes it difficult to move.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You conjure a chilling mist that settles into the bones and makes it difficult to move. This has the effects of Mist, except that you can Sustain the spell once per round to move the fog up to 10 feet. A creature that starts its turn in the area takes 6d8 cold damage with a basic Fortitude save. A creature that fails its save is also Clumsy 1 for 1 minute (Clumsy 2 on a critical failure) and takes a –10-foot status penalty to Speeds for as long as it's clumsy.

Spell Effect: Frozen Fog

**Heightened (+2)** The damage increases by 3d8.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Heartbolt
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.targets: 1 willing living creature or 1 undead creature
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: Your heart ejects a bolt of pure life energy, which plunges into the body of your target before it explodes into a plume of vital energy.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
Your heart ejects a bolt of pure life energy, which plunges into the body of your target before it explodes into a plume of vital energy. If the target is a willing living creature, it regains 3d10+15 Hit Points. If the target is undead, the bolt deals that amount of vitality damage to it instead, with a basic Fortitude save.

The energy then explodes outward, affecting all other creatures within a 20-foot emanation from the original target, healing living creatures for level-based Hit Points and dealing level-based vitality damage to undead creatures with a basic Fortitude saving throw.

**Heightened (+2)** The amount of healing or damage the original target receives increases by 1d10+5, and the healing or damage that all creatures receive from the emanation increases by 5.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Incarnate Wild Rose
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.duration: until the end of your next turn
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You call up the giant wild rose, a flower famous for both its beauty and its thorns.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You call up the giant wild rose, a flower famous for both its beauty and its thorns. The rose occupies the space of a Huge creature but has no Speed.

**Arrive** *Writhing Vines* A vast number of thorny vines burst from the ground, wrapping around those who threaten you. Each enemy within a 30-foot emanation of the rose takes level-based piercing damage and must attempt a Reflex saving throw.

**Critical Success** The creature takes no damage.

**Success** The creature takes half damage.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and is grabbed by a vine for the duration of the spell or until they Escape.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage and is restrained by a vine for the duration of the spell or until they Escape.

**Depart** (poison) *Blood Pollen* All creatures still grabbed or restrained by vines take level-based persistent poison damage. The wild rose then expels a cloud of toxic pollen in a 20-foot burst up to 60 feet away. All living creatures in the burst must attempt a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is Enfeebled 2 for 1 round.

**Failure** The creature is enfeebled 2 for 1 minute.

**Critical Failure** The creature is Enfeebled 3 for 1 minute.

**Heightened (+2)** The rose's arrival damage increases by 1d12, and its departure damage increases by 1d6.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Incarnate Wild Rose

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Living Thunderbolt
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You transform into a being of pure lightning, allowing you to move at impossible speeds.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You transform into a being of pure lightning, allowing you to move at impossible speeds. You gain a fly Speed of 60 feet, resistance 10 to electricity, and automatically succeed at attempts to Escape an effect that has you immobilized, grabbed, or restrained unless the effect is magical and of a higher rank than the *living thunderbolt* spell. Additionally, you can move through creatures' spaces as if they weren't there, but you can't end your movement in another creature's space. When you move through a creature's space, they take 4d12 electricity damage with a basic Reflex save. On a failure, they're also dazzled for 1 round. A creature can only take damage this way once per round.

Spell Effect: Living Thunderbolt

**Heightened (+2)** The electricity resistance increases by 5 and the damage dealt when you move through a creature's space increases by 1d12.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Necrotize
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You necrotize part of a creature's body, harming them and debilitating them as their body putrefies, mimicking the natural process of decay.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You necrotize part of a creature's body, harming them and debilitating them as their body putrefies, mimicking the natural process of decay. The target takes 12d6 void damage and one of the following debilitations; roll 1d4 to randomly determine which. The effects depend on their Fortitude save.

1. **Bones** The target's bones necrotize and become spongy and weak, giving them weakness 3 to bludgeoning damage.
2. **Joints** The target's joints necrotize, making its movements ungainly and clumsy. They become Clumsy 1.
3. **Legs** The target's legs (or any other limbs associated with forms of movement) necrotize, making it harder for the creature to move. The target takes a –10-foot status penalty to their Speeds.
4. **Muscles** The target's muscles necrotize, rotting away. The target becomes Enfeebled 1.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes half damage and the debilitation lasts until the end of your next turn.

Spell Effect: Necrotize (Success)

**Failure** The target takes full damage and the debilitation lasts for 1 minute.

Spell Effect: Necrotize (Failure)

**Critical Failure** The target takes double damage, and you can pick a second debilitation to apply, in addition to the one you rolled randomly. Both debilitations last for 1 minute.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Patron's Protector
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You channel your magic into your familiar, filling its body with dreadful energy, turning them into a powerful protective force.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You channel your magic into your familiar, filling its body with dreadful energy, turning them into a powerful protective force. You can use Command an Animal on the target as part of Casting or Sustaining this spell. Your familiar's AC becomes 28; they become large, and they gain 20 temporary Hit Points. If your familiar is reduced to 0 Hit Points while under the effect of this spell, the spell immediately ends, and your familiar is instead reduced to 1 Hit Point. Once per turn your familiar can use the Body Check or Protector's Shove action.

**Body Check**◆ Your familiar uses its new size and presence to press against an adjacent creature, dealing, 4d10 bludgeoning damage (basic Fortitude save). On a failed save, the target is also knocked back 10 feet (20 feet on a critical failure).

**Protector's Shove** ◆ Your familiar shoves an ally out of danger. Your familiar pushes an adjacent, willing ally, pushing them up to 20 feet away and granting them a +2 status bonus to AC for 1 round. This is forced movement.

**Heightened (9th)** The familiar's AC become 36, they gain 30 temporary Hit Points, and the damage increases by 2d10.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Poltergeist's Fury
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: Your fury spills over in a telekinetic storm of terrifying proportions.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
Your fury spills over in a telekinetic storm of terrifying proportions. Any loose, unattended objects of 1 Bulk or less within range are picked up and begin to orbit you at breathtaking speeds. All creatures in the area take 6d4 piercing damage with a basic Reflex save. Each time you Sustain the spell, you can increase the radius of the storm by 10 feet, to a maximum of 100 feet. The storm moves with you and provides you with lesser cover, though you can't use this cover to hide or sneak. Allies within the storm who roll a success on their Reflex save against your poltergeist's fury get a critical success instead, as you attempt to avoid hitting them.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d4.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Proximal Shift
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: With a thunderous crack, you disappear from your current location and reappear in an unoccupied space within range that you can see, bringing all non-magical, non-living, unattended matter…
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description: With a thunderous crack, you disappear from your current location and reappear in an unoccupied space within range that you can see, bringing all non-magical, non-living, unattended matter (including objects) in a 5-foot emanation with you. Creatures within the emanation must succeed at a Reflex save to avoid falling into the crater you leave behind, taking 5 bludgeoning damage and falling prone. Creatures in a 5-foot emanation on your arrival space take 6d6 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex save from the resulting explosion of debris, and the area becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute. At the GM's discretion, the spell might have additional effects based on the nature of the material teleported with you. If the teleport would cause you to bring another creature—even one inside an extradimensional container—the spell fails.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Seize Identity
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.traits: rare, concentrate, illusion, manipulate, mental, mythic, visual
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: With a gleeful cackle, you seize an individual's voice and swallow it.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
With a gleeful cackle, you seize an individual's voice and swallow it. For the duration, you look and sound like the target, and the target can't speak. The effects depend on the result of the target's Will saving throw.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** You take on the target's appearance, with the same effects of a 3rd-rank Illusory Disguise spell, and the target can't speak, with the same effects of a 2nd-rank Silence spell.

**Failure** As success, but the target also takes 4d6 mental damage from the transformation.

**Critical Failure** As success, but the target also takes 8d6 mental damage from the transformation.

The first time each round you Sustain this spell after you cast this spell, the target ages rapidly, taking level-based void damage (basic Will save). On a failure, the target also becomes Enfeebled 1 or increases the value of its enfeebled condition by 1.

**Heightened (9th)** The mental damage increases by 4d6, and the void damage increases by 1d8.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.cite: War of Immortals — Spells: Seize Identity

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Siege Weapon's Blessing
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: You trace a magic rune onto the body of a siege weapon, calling upon fate or your faith to guide the attacks your allies make with this machine.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
You trace a magic rune onto the body of a siege weapon, calling upon fate or your faith to guide the attacks your allies make with this machine. For the spell's duration, any skill checks attempted to Load the siege weapon can be rolled twice, taking the better result; these skill checks gain the fortune trait. In addition, any saving throws attempted by creatures caught in the siege weapon's Launch area must be rolled twice, taking the worse result; these saving throws gain the misfortune trait.

**Heightened (9th)** The duration is 8 hours.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Skeleton Army
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.duration: until the end of your next turn
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: With a fistful of compressed bones, you summon a legion of skeletal hulks to fight in your war, refusing to let them rest until they've given up their last inches of usefulness to your cause.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
With a fistful of compressed bones, you summon a legion of skeletal hulks to fight in your war, refusing to let them rest until they've given up their last inches of usefulness to your cause. The undead army occupies the space of a Huge creature and has a Speed of 40 feet.

**Arrive** *Bone March* The skeletal hulks rise from the dirt, slashing through your enemies and attacking with their dirt-encrusted, bony hands. Enemies within a 20-foot emanation take 4d8 slashing damage (basic Reflex save). On a critical failure, a creature also take 2d8 persistent bleed damage.

**Depart** *Tossed Heads* Before crumpling into a pile of bones, the skeleton army removes their skulls and throws them at the enemy lines, chattering and howling, dealing 6d6 piercing damage to enemies in a 20-foot burst (basic Reflex save) within 30 feet. On a critical failure, a creature is also Frightened 2.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Speak With Water
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: Using ancient magic, you shape the words you speak into the primal sounds of water.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
Using ancient magic, you shape the words you speak into the primal sounds of water. You can ask questions of and receive answers from a body of water or the rain. While water isn't intelligent, you speak with the natural spirits within the water, which have a personality colored by the type of water as well as the activity and movement of the water. Water's perspective, perception, and knowledge give it a worldview different enough from a human's that it doesn't consider the same details important. Rain is fleeting and knows only what it's currently touching. It can direct you toward unique silhouettes or structures or find a hidden place under a city as rain washes through the sewers. A body of water's perspective is shaped by its size and age. A lake might remember when a fisherman drowned within them, but the ocean will likely only recall the most significant of events, such as a city sinking beneath their waves.

**Heightened (7th)** The duration is 8 hours.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Speak With Water

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Suspended Retribution
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: All life dances one step from the precipice, one heartbeat from disaster.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
All life dances one step from the precipice, one heartbeat from disaster. You open your eyes wide and see doom waiting in the wings, then invite it to step forward. A spectral omen of disaster appears above the target's head—traditionally, this is a downward-pointing sword, but some spellcasters report seeing a hangman's noose or a grinning skull instead. When you Cast this Spell, pick one of the following triggers.

- The target moves more than its Speed in a single round.
- The target makes more than one Strike in a single round.
- The target Casts a Spell.
- The target uses a specific skill you name.
- The target uses a specific ability you name.

The target uses a specific ability you name. If the target takes the triggering action, the portent of doom activates—the sword strikes down, the noose loops around the target's neck, the skull bares its fangs—and the target takes 70 mental damage with a basic Reflex save. The target instinctively knows which action will trigger the omen and can ward off the omen by spending a total of 3 actions, which have the concentrate trait, to pray, make signs against doom, or similar apotropaic actions. These actions need not be consecutive. After the creature spends the actions, the spell ends.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 10.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Tentacular Innervation
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: One of your limbs blisters and your muscles extend to create a nestling assemblage of tentacles.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
One of your limbs blisters and your muscles extend to create a nestling assemblage of tentacles. This visceral mass is a shortlived magical parasite that seeks to connect to an unfortunate foe's nervous system. Make an unarmed melee Strike. Your reach increases by 10 feet for this Strike. If the Strike hits, in addition to dealing its normal damage, the target becomes Sickened 1 and is grabbed by the mass of tentacles. The target isn't immobilized, but it can't move beyond the reach of the unarmed melee Strike that has grabbed it. If the target Escapes from the mass of tentacles (using your spell DC as the Escape DC), the spell ends. The mass of tentacles can be severed before the spell's duration ends; it has AC 10 and 60 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage.

**Heightened (+1)** The Hit Points of the tentacles increases by 10.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.name: Unexpected Transposition
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.targets: 1 creature other than the triggering enemy
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.summary: When attacked, you attempt to quickly swap your own position with that of another creature, causing them to get hit in your place.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-5-6.description:
**Trigger** You are targeted with an enemy's Strike.

When attacked, you attempt to quickly swap your own position with that of another creature, causing them to get hit in your place. A creature that's unwilling to swap places with you must attempt a Will save. Willing creatures automatically fail, and you switch places. If you successfully switch places with the target, the triggering attack is resolved against that creature as if it had been the original target of the attack. After the swap, you and the target are both temporarily immune to *unexpected transposition* spells for 1 minute.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.name: Angel Form
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.duration: 1 minute
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.summary: Invoking the celestial realms, you transform into a Medium angel battle form.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.description:
Invoking the celestial realms, you transform into a Medium angel battle form. When you Cast this Spell, choose balisse, choral, kuribu, or tennin. The battle form is Small if you choose choral or kuribu. While in this form, you gain the angel, celestial, and holy traits. You have hands in this battle form and can use manipulate actions. You can Dismiss the spell.

You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of the form that you choose:

- AC = 22 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction. 40 temporary Hit Points and weakness 10 to unholy.
- Darkvision.
- One or more attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +25, and your damage bonus is +12. Melee attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example), and ranged attacks are Dexterity based. If your attack modifier is higher for the given unarmed attack or weapon, you can use it instead.
- Athletics modifier of +25, unless your own modifier is higher.

You also gain specific abilities based on the type of angel you choose:

- **Balisse** Speed 30 feet, fly 40 feet; Perception modifier of +26 to detect lies and illusions unless your own modifier is higher: **Melee** ◆ scimitar (fire, forceful, holy, magical, sweep), **Damage** 2d6 slashing plus 2d6 fire.
- **Choral** Speed 30 feet, fly 40 feet; +1 status bonus to AC and saves against auditory and sonic: **Melee** ◆ fist (agile, holy, magical, unarmed), **Damage** 2d6 bludgeoning; **Ranged** ◆ piercing hymn (holy, magical, range 90 feet), **Damage** 3d6 sonic and deafened for 1 round on a critical hit.
- **Kuribu** Speed 25 feet, fly 40 feet; resistance 10 to electricity and fire: **Melee** ◆ fist (agile, holy, magical, unarmed), **Damage** 3d4 bludgeoning; **Ranged** ◆ composite shortbow (deadly 2d10, holy, magical, propulsive, range increment 60 feet), **Damage** 3d6 piercing.
- **Tennin** Speed 30 feet, fly 60 feet; can Step into difficult terrain and use land and fly Speeds to Step: **Melee** ◆ fist (agile, holy, magical, nonlethal, unarmed), **Damage** 1d6 bludgeoning plus 1d6 cold and 1d6 spirit.

Spell Effect: Angel Form

**Heightened (9th)** Your battle form is Large if you choose balisse or tennin. You must have space to expand into, or the spell is lost. You instead gain AC = 22 + your level, 60 temporary Hit Points, weakness 15 to unholy, attack modifier +30, damage bonus +20, and Athletics +33.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.name: Comet Charge
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.summary: Wreathed in elemental power, you launch yourself toward a target to deliver a mighty blow.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.description:
Wreathed in elemental power, you launch yourself toward a target to deliver a mighty blow. You Fly up to 120 feet in a straight line to an empty space adjacent to the target creature and make a melee spell attack. This movement doesn't trigger reactions, and you can fly through other creatures as part of this movement. If you began this movement at a higher elevation than your target, it's off-guard against this attack.

When you Cast this Spell, choose one of the elemental effects below. The spell gains the traits listed, and the melee spell attack gains the chosen elemental effect.

- **Comet of Acid** (acid, earth) You're wreathed in blistering acid. If you hit, the target takes 6d6 acid damage and 4d6 persistent acid damage. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage.
- **Comet of Fire** (fire) You're wreathed in a fiery blaze. If you hit, the target takes 14d6 fire damage. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage.
- **Comet of Ice** (cold, water) You're wreathed in a freezing mist. If you hit, the target takes 12d6 cold damage and takes a –15-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 minute. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage.
- **Comet of Lightning** (air, electricity) You're wreathed in jolting electricity. If you hit, the target takes 6d12 electricity damage and is dazzled for 1 round. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage.
- **Comet of Rust** (metal) You're wreathed in a cloud of rust. If you hit, the target takes 10d8 slashing damage, or 10d10 slashing damage if the target is wearing metal armor or is primarily made of metal. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage.
- **Comet of Splinters** (wood) You're wreathed in painful splinters. If you hit, the target takes 10d6 piercing damage and is Clumsy 1 for 1 minute. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage. The target can Interact to remove the splinters and end the clumsy condition inflicted by this spell.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.name: Cosmic Form
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.duration: 1 minute
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.summary: You recreate your form entirely out of cosmic energy, transforming into a Large battle form.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.description:
You recreate your form entirely out of cosmic energy, transforming into a Large battle form. You must have enough space to expand into, or the spell is lost. When you Cast this Spell, choose to take on the powers of the moon or the sun. You have hands in this battle form and can use manipulate actions. You can Dismiss the spell.

You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of the form that you choose:

- AC = 21 + your level. Ignore your armor check's penalty and Speed reduction.
- 20 temporary Hit Points.
- Darkvision.
- One or more attacks specific to the battle form you use, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +25, and your damage bonus is +10. The melee attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example), and the ranged attacks are Dexterity based. If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.
- Athletics modifier of +25, unless your own is higher.

You also gain specific abilities based on the stellar body:

- **Moon** Speed 30 feet, fly 50 feet: **Melee** ◆ fist (agile, reach 10 feet, unarmed), **Damage** 2d4 bludgeoning plus 1d6 fire; **Ranged** ◆ moonbeam (range 90 feet), **Damage** 2d4 fire; this form's fire damage is silver for resistances, weaknesses, and the like; On a critical hit with either Strike, the target is Stupefied 2 for 1 round.
- **Sun** Speed 30 feet, fly 50 feet: **Melee** ◆ fist (agile, reach 10 feet, unarmed), **Damage** 2d6 fire plus 1d6 persistent fire; **Ranged** ◆ sunbeam (range 90 feet), **Damage** 1d6 fire plus 1d6 persistent fire; On a critical hit with either Strike, the target is dazzled for 1 round.

Spell Effect: Cosmic Form

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.name: Defy the Gods
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.summary: You've obtained your abilities through sheer mental effort, unaided by any higher powers, and now you drain away what the undeserving have gained through divine shortcuts.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.description:
You've obtained your abilities through sheer mental effort, unaided by any higher powers, and now you drain away what the undeserving have gained through divine shortcuts. If the target has the divine, holy, or unholy trait and becomes drained by this spell, you gain resistance 15 to holy and unholy for 1 minute.

Spell Effect: Defy the Gods

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is Drained 1 and Stupefied 1 for 1 round.

**Failure** The creature is Drained 2 and Stupefied 2 for 1 minute.

**Critical Failure** The creature is Drained 3 and Stupefied 3 for 1 minute.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Defy the Gods

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.name: Deity's Strike
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.traits: attack, concentrate, force, manipulate, sanctified, spirit
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.summary: A manifested version of your deity's favored weapon made of pure magical might appears in the air above the target.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.description:
A manifested version of your deity's favored weapon made of pure magical might appears in the air above the target. This weapon attacks using your spell attack modifier. On a hit, the weapon deals 7d12 force damage, or double damage on a critical hit.

After the attack, whether it succeeds or fails, divine energy bursts from the weapon in a shock wave. It emits in a 10-foot-wide, 30-foot-long line line starting from the target and continuing in a direction you choose. Your target and any other creatures within the area of the spell take level-based spirit damage, with a basic Reflex save.

**Heightened (9th)** The force damage increases by 1d12, and the spirit damage increases by 1d6.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.name: Fiendish Rift
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.duration: sustained up to 1 minute
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.summary: You open a tear in reality that leads to a fiendish plane such as the daemonic wastes, Hell, or the demonic realms.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.description:
You open a tear in reality that leads to a fiendish plane such as the daemonic wastes, Hell, or the demonic realms. Fiends reach out of the rift, grabbing at creatures with various appendages. When you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain it each turn on subsequent rounds, each creature in the area takes 7d6 spirit damage; creatures with the holy trait take an additional 10 spirit damage. An affected creature attempts a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and is grabbed for 1 round or until it Escapes.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage and is restrained for 1 round or until it Escapes.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d6.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.name: Final Fate of the Locust Host
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.duration: until the end of your next turn
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.summary: The corpse is riddled with vermin, including countless locusts, whose collective movement grants the corpse a Speed of 60 feet and a fly Speed of 60 feet.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.description:
The corpse is riddled with vermin, including countless locusts, whose collective movement grants the corpse a Speed of 60 feet and a fly Speed of 60 feet.

A loud, persistent buzzing is created by the clouds of locusts surrounding it like a haze. Each living enemy creature within a 60-foot emanation must attempt a Fortitude save with the following effects.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is Sickened 2.

**Failure** The creature is Sickened 3 and deafened for the duration.

**Critical Failure** The creature is Sickened 4, Stunned 1, and deafened for the duration.

This swarm deals 5d8 piercing damage and 5d8 poison damage to enemy creatures in a 60-foot emanation with a basic Reflex save. A creature that critically fails is additionally Drained 2.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.cite: War of Immortals — Spells: Final Fate of the Locust Host

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.name: Frigid Flurry
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.summary: You place a palm to your lips and exhale a cold breath, whipping up a gust of wind that freezes the air's ambient moisture into a flurry of jagged shards.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.description:
**Area** (continued) line up to 120 feet

You place a palm to your lips and exhale a cold breath, whipping up a gust of wind that freezes the air's ambient moisture into a flurry of jagged shards. The flurry deals 9d6 cold damage and 9d6 slashing damage to all foes, with a basic Reflex save, but the gust flows harmlessly around your allies. The wind then picks you up and carries you to the other end of the area. While carried this way, you temporarily transform into a flurry of snow crystals and become immune to all damage and effects except fire damage, effects with the fire trait, and any other effect the GM decides would affect snow.

**Heightened (+1)** The cold and slashing damage each increase by 1d6

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.name: Incarnate Ancient Specter
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.duration: until the end of your next turn
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.summary: You invoke an ancient wraith to appear and fight by your side.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.description:
You invoke an ancient wraith to appear and fight by your side. This specter may be the spirit of some long-dead king or warlord. It occupies the space of a Medium creature and has a fly Speed of 40 feet.

**Arrive** (mental, visual) *Kneel, Peons!* The specter raises its hand, indicating that all foes should pay it obeisance. All enemies within a 60-foot emanation of the specter must attempt a Will save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature kneels, dropping prone as a free action.

**Failure** As success, and the creature can't Stand for the duration of the spell.

**Critical Failure** As failure, and the creature also bows its head, becoming dazzled for the duration of the spell.

**Depart** (auditory, emotion, mental) *Listen and Weep* The specter speaks, and though its words have no meaning, they convey a terrible tragedy. All living enemies that have both eyes and blood (or a reasonable equivalent) within a 30-foot emanation begin to weep tears of blood. They take 4d6 persistent bleed damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a failure, a creature is also dazzled for as long as they take the persistent bleed damage.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Incarnate Ancient Specter

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.name: Incarnate Tempest of Shades
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.duration: until the end of your next turn
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.summary: You channel the forces of undeath to briefly call forth an amalgam of the vengeful dead slain by your enemies and allies alike.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.description:
You channel the forces of undeath to briefly call forth an amalgam of the vengeful dead slain by your enemies and allies alike. This amalgam manifests as a large tornado of insubstantial, howling faces. It occupies the space of a Huge creature and has a Speed of 60 feet.

**Arrive** (void) *Vortex of Death* Each enemy creature within a 60-foot emanation must attempt a Fortitude save with the following effects.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected

**Success** The creature is Drained 1.

**Failure** The creature is Drained 2.

**Critical Failure** The creature is Drained 3.

**Depart** (emotion, fear, mental) *Howl of Eternity* The vengeful dead lets out an anguished scream. All your enemies within a 100-foot emanation must attempt Will saves with the following effects.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is Frightened 1.

**Failure** The creature is Frightened 3.

**Critical Failure** The creature is frightened 3. It's also fleeing for 1 round or until it's no longer frightened, whichever comes first.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Incarnate Tempest of Shades

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.name: Infinitesimal Collapse Field
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.duration: sustained up to 1 minute
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.summary: As your enemies attempt to approach you, you create a field around yourself that warps and stretches space and time.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.description:
As your enemies attempt to approach you, you create a field around yourself that warps and stretches space and time. The first time an enemy enters or starts their turn in the emanation, they must attempt a Fortitude save. If a target affected by the spell leaves the spell's area and later re-enters it, the spell's effects resume based on their previous saving throw.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is encumbered while in the area of the spell.

**Failure** The target is encumbered and Slowed 1 while in the area of the spell.

**Critical Failure** The target is encumbered, Slowed 1, and cannot take reactions while in the area of the spell.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.cite: Impossible Magic — Spells: Infinitesimal Collapse Field

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.name: Momentary Recovery
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.summary: You instantly teleport yourself and any items you're wearing or holding from your current space to a clear space within range that you can see.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.description: You instantly teleport yourself and any items you're wearing or holding from your current space to a clear space within range that you can see. If this teleportation would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost. After you vanish but before you arrive, you can take up to 2 actions (or the number of actions you spent to cast *momentary recovery*, if it was fewer than 2 actions). You can't target any other creatures or objects with anything during these actions and any effect with a duration that you create during these actions ends immediately when you arrive. After you arrive, you are Slowed 1 until the end of your next turn.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.name: Puppet Strings
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.duration: sustained up to 1 minute
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.summary: Ethereal threads emanate from your fingertips and flow toward the target, connecting to its arms, legs, and body.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.description:
Ethereal threads emanate from your fingertips and flow toward the target, connecting to its arms, legs, and body. The target must attempt a Reflex save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The strings impede the target's movements, but you can't control them. The target is Clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn.

**Failure** The target is clumsy 1 and Slowed 1. Additionally, when you Cast this Spell and the first time you Sustain it on subsequent turns, you can force the target to Stride or Strike. If you force the target to Stride, you determine the path it takes; you can't force it to Stride into a space where it can't stand easily. This is forced movement. If you cause the creature to Strike, it makes a melee Strike against a creature within its reach using your spell attack modifier. The target can't hit itself this way. On a hit, the Strike deals 7d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, as appropriate. None of the target's equipment or abilities modify this Strike. This Strike contributes to and uses your multiple attack penalty. At the end of its turn, the target can attempt a Fortitude save against your spell DC to free itself from the threads. On a success, the spell ends.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target is Slowed 2, and you can force the target to use 2 actions when you Cast or Sustain the spell.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.name: Shadow Raid
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.duration: 1 minute
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.summary: You spin illusions of flying shadows throughout the area.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.description:
**Defense** basic Reflex or Will (target's choice)

You spin illusions of flying shadows throughout the area. The shadows strike and cavort, harming your foes and blocking their vision with twisting shadow. Enemies in the area when you Cast the Spell take 6d8 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, with a basic Reflex or basic Will save, as shadows explode into being. You choose the damage type when you Cast the Spell, and each creature chooses the type of save it attempts before it rolls the save. The shadows then persist in the area for 1 minute, dealing 3d8 damage of the type you chose to any enemy that ends its turn in the area. All creatures are concealed to enemies in the area, as the illusory shadows swarm over them and block light.

A creature that spends an action to Seek or otherwise interact with the shadow raid can attempt a Perception check to disbelieve it. On a success, the creature halves the damage it takes from the shadows, and the shadows no longer impede its vision. These benefits last until the spell ends.

**Heightened (9th)** The initial damage increases by 2d8, and the damage to a creature that ends its turn in the area increases by 1d8 (4d8).

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.name: Summon Stampede
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.duration: until the end of your next turn
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.summary: You summon an unstoppable stampede of panicking beasts.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.description:
You summon an unstoppable stampede of panicking beasts. Whether you conjure wild beasts or tamed cattle, the stampede is a force of nature that leaves behind nothing in its wake. The stampede occupies the space of a Gargantuan creature and has a Speed of 60 feet.

**Arrive**(emotion, fear, mental) *Foreboding Tremors* The sheer energy of a stampede can cause even apex predators to panic. Each creature within a 60-foot emanation must attempt a Will save with the following effects.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is Frightened 1.

**Failure** The creature is Frightened 2.

**Critical Failure** The creature is Frightened 3 and fleeing for 1 round.

**Depart***Flatten the Earth* The stampede Strides up to double its Speed, trampling each Large or smaller creature, hazard, and structure whose space it enters, dealing 8d8 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex save). The stampede ignores and attempts to counteract all difficult terrain it enters caused by debris, overgrowth, rubble, or thick ground cover.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.cite: Howl of the Wild — Spells: Summon Stampede

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.name: Telekinetic Bombardment
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.summary: You grasp a piece of the landscape—such as a tree, carriage, or piece of masonry—and lob it in your foe's direction.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.description:
You grasp a piece of the landscape—such as a tree, carriage, or piece of masonry—and lob it in your foe's direction. Your missile crashes down in either a 10-foot burst (for most missiles) or a 30-foot line (for something long and tall, like a tree or a ship's mast), dealing 14d6 bludgeoning damage and turning its area into difficult terrain as it breaks into rubble. All creatures in the area must attempt a Reflex save. If the area is a line, it doesn't have to start from your square but can instead start anywhere in range, as long as the entire area remains within range.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and is knocked prone.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage, is knocked prone, and is Stunned 1.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.name: Time Beacon
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.duration: until the end of your turn
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.summary: You create a beacon in time to return to it if things go wrong.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.description: You create a beacon in time to return to it if things go wrong. You can cast *time beacon* only on your turn. Keep careful track of everything that happens this turn after you cast *time beacon*. At the end of your turn, you can choose to rewind time back to just after you cast *time beacon*, removing all effects of your turn since then. Curses, traps, and other harmful effects that happen during your turn might prevent you from returning to the beacon if they're powerful enough. If you were affected by any harmful effects during your turn after casting *time beacon*, in order to return to your beacon, *time beacon* attempts a counteract check against each such effect. If it fails at any of these checks, you can't return. After returning to the time beacon, the spell ends.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.name: Amalgamizing Leap
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.traits: uncommon, concentrate, incapacitation, manipulate, polymorph, teleportation
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.duration: until the end of your next turn
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.summary: You choose a location within range that you can see and haphazardly catapult yourself and the target through space, attempting to violate one of the cardinal laws of teleportation by intertwining…
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.description:
You choose a location within range that you can see and haphazardly catapult yourself and the target through space, attempting to violate one of the cardinal laws of teleportation by intertwining your own magical signature with that of the target creature as if you both were a single being. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected, but you're instantly transported to the chosen space.

**Success** You and a piece of the target are transported to the chosen location, fused together. The target becomes Enfeebled 1, and you gain 20 temporary Hit Points until the end of your next turn.

**Failure** You and the target creature vanish from your current locations and reappear in the chosen space fused together until the end of your next turn. While fused together, you also gain the following effects.

- You gain 40 temporary Hit Points that last for the duration of the spell.
- You gain all Speeds possessed by the target, unless you already have a higher Speed of that kind.
- You gain all special senses possessed by the target.

Your reach increases by 5 feet. While fused, the target creature doesn't occupy space, is unable to act, and can't be targeted or affected by attacks or other effects. The target does remain aware of its environment and everything transpiring around it. At the end of your next turn, the target separates from you in an adjacent space. Both you and the target return to your original forms.

**Critical Failure** As failure, except the target also becomes Sickened 1.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.name: Burning Blossoms
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.duration: 1 minute
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.summary: An intangible hollow tree grows to towering height, radiating a fiery passion and fascinating viewers.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.description:
**Area** 30-foot radius, 100-foot tall cylinder

An intangible hollow tree grows to towering height, radiating a fiery passion and fascinating viewers. The base of the tree takes up a single square and grows 100 feet upward, while its branches extend outward 30 feet, forming the spell's cylindrical area. The tree then blossoms, growing delicate white flowers that burn with white-hot fire. As the tree's branches gently rustle in the wind, flower petals drift to the ground in a shower of flame. Any creature that ends its turn under the tree's branches takes 6d6 fire damage from the burning petals. Any enemy that can see the tree, even if the enemy is outside the spell's area, must attempt a Will save. This is an emotion, mental, and visual effect. Creatures fascinated with the tree must use at least one of their actions on each of their turns to move toward the tree.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune for 24 hours.

**Success** The creature is unaffected, but it must attempt a new save at the end of its turn if it can still see the tree.

**Failure** The creature is fascinated with the tree until the end of its next turn. If it can still see the tree at the end of its turn, it must attempt a new save.

**Critical Failure** The creature is fascinated with the tree until the spell ends. The tree's fire damage doesn't end the fascination, but other hostile actions end it as normal. If the fascination ends, the creature must attempt a new save at the end of its turn if it can still see the tree.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d6.

pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.name: Clockwork Devotion
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.duration: until the end of your next turn
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.summary: You toss a handful of magical cogs before you, summoning a battalion of clockwork soldiers to fight your enemies.
pf2e-orc.spells.rank-7-10.description:
